## File: src/client/audio/AudioController.luau
````
--!strict
--[[
	AudioController.luau
	Procedural velocity audio controller and pooled weapon/UI sound dispatcher.
	Modulates a continuous wind-rush loop volume and PlaybackSpeed proportional to
	MovementController.CurrentPlanarSpeed when B-hopping above 35 studs/s, and triggers
	landing thuds via MovementController.OnLandedCallbacks.
]]

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local SoundService = game:GetService("SoundService")

local SharedConfigs = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Shared"):WaitForChild("configs")
local AssetRegistry = require(SharedConfigs:WaitForChild("AssetRegistry"))
local MovementController = require(script.Parent.Parent:WaitForChild("movement"):WaitForChild("MovementController"))

local WEAPON_SOUND_POOL_SIZE = 12
local UI_SOUND_POOL_SIZE = 8
local MOVEMENT_SOUND_POOL_SIZE = 4

local WIND_RUSH_SPEED_THRESHOLD = 35
local WIND_RUSH_MAX_SPEED = 95
local WIND_MAX_VOLUME = 0.65
local WIND_MIN_PLAYBACK_SPEED = 0.85
local WIND_MAX_PLAYBACK_SPEED = 1.45
local WIND_LERP_SPEED = 10

local initialized = false
local weaponSoundPool: { Sound } = table.create(WEAPON_SOUND_POOL_SIZE)
local weaponPoolCursor = 0

local uiSoundPool: { Sound } = table.create(UI_SOUND_POOL_SIZE)
local uiPoolCursor = 0

local movementSoundPool: { Sound } = table.create(MOVEMENT_SOUND_POOL_SIZE)
local movementPoolCursor = 0

local windRushSound: Sound? = nil
local renderConnection: RBXScriptConnection? = nil
local rng = Random.new()

local AudioController = {}

local function getOrCreateSoundGroup(name: string): SoundGroup
	local existing = SoundService:FindFirstChild(name)
	if existing and existing:IsA("SoundGroup") then
		return existing
	end
	local group = Instance.new("SoundGroup")
	group.Name = name
	group.Volume = 1
	group.Parent = SoundService
	return group
end

local function ensurePoolsInitialized(): ()
	if #weaponSoundPool > 0 then
		return
	end

	local weaponGroup = getOrCreateSoundGroup("WeaponsAudioGroup")
	local uiGroup = getOrCreateSoundGroup("UIAudioGroup")
	local movementGroup = getOrCreateSoundGroup("MovementAudioGroup")

	for i = 1, WEAPON_SOUND_POOL_SIZE do
		local sound = Instance.new("Sound")
		sound.Name = string.format("PooledWeaponSound_%02d", i)
		sound.Volume = 0.55
		sound.SoundGroup = weaponGroup
		sound.Parent = weaponGroup
		weaponSoundPool[i] = sound
	end

	for i = 1, UI_SOUND_POOL_SIZE do
		local sound = Instance.new("Sound")
		sound.Name = string.format("PooledUISound_%02d", i)
		sound.Volume = 0.6
		sound.SoundGroup = uiGroup
		sound.Parent = uiGroup
		uiSoundPool[i] = sound
	end

	for i = 1, MOVEMENT_SOUND_POOL_SIZE do
		local sound = Instance.new("Sound")
		sound.Name = string.format("PooledMovementSound_%02d", i)
		sound.Volume = 0.45
		sound.SoundGroup = movementGroup
		sound.Parent = movementGroup
		movementSoundPool[i] = sound
	end

	local wind = Instance.new("Sound")
	wind.Name = "BhopWindRushLoop"
	wind.SoundId = AssetRegistry.Audio.Movement.WindRushLoop
	wind.Looped = true
	wind.Volume = 0
	wind.PlaybackSpeed = WIND_MIN_PLAYBACK_SPEED
	wind.SoundGroup = movementGroup
	wind.Parent = movementGroup
	wind:Play()
	windRushSound = wind
end

local function resolveWeaponSoundId(soundKey: string): string?
	local weaponsTable = AssetRegistry.Audio.Weapons :: { [string]: string }
	if weaponsTable[soundKey] then
		return weaponsTable[soundKey]
	end
	if string.sub(soundKey, 1, 13) == "rbxassetid://" then
		return soundKey
	end
	return weaponsTable.PulseRifleFire
end

local function resolveUISoundId(soundKey: string): string?
	local uiTable = AssetRegistry.Audio.UI :: { [string]: string }
	if uiTable[soundKey] then
		return uiTable[soundKey]
	end
	if string.sub(soundKey, 1, 13) == "rbxassetid://" then
		return soundKey
	end
	return uiTable.HitmarkerBody
end

local function getCurrentPlanarSpeed(): number
	local movementAny = MovementController :: any
	if type(movementAny.CurrentPlanarSpeed) == "number" then
		return movementAny.CurrentPlanarSpeed
	end
	if type(movementAny.GetPlanarSpeed) == "function" then
		local ok, speed = pcall(movementAny.GetPlanarSpeed, movementAny)
		if ok and type(speed) == "number" then
			return speed
		end
	end
	return 0
end

local function playLandingThud(impactVelocity: number?): ()
	ensurePoolsInitialized()

	movementPoolCursor = (movementPoolCursor % MOVEMENT_SOUND_POOL_SIZE) + 1
	local sound = movementSoundPool[movementPoolCursor]
	sound.SoundId = AssetRegistry.Audio.Movement.BhopLand

	local planarSpeed = getCurrentPlanarSpeed()
	local effectiveSpeed = math.max(planarSpeed, math.abs(impactVelocity or 0))
	local speedFactor = math.clamp(effectiveSpeed / WIND_RUSH_MAX_SPEED, 0, 1)

	sound.Volume = 0.3 + (0.4 * speedFactor)
	sound.PlaybackSpeed = 0.9 + (0.22 * speedFactor) + rng:NextNumber(-0.03, 0.03)
	sound.TimePosition = 0
	sound:Play()
end

local function updateWindRushAudio(dt: number): ()
	local wind = windRushSound
	if not wind then
		return
	end

	local planarSpeed = getCurrentPlanarSpeed()
	local targetVolume = 0
	local targetPitch = WIND_MIN_PLAYBACK_SPEED

	if planarSpeed > WIND_RUSH_SPEED_THRESHOLD then
		local speedSpan = math.max(WIND_RUSH_MAX_SPEED - WIND_RUSH_SPEED_THRESHOLD, 1)
		local alpha = math.clamp((planarSpeed - WIND_RUSH_SPEED_THRESHOLD) / speedSpan, 0, 1)
		targetVolume = WIND_MAX_VOLUME * alpha
		targetPitch = WIND_MIN_PLAYBACK_SPEED + (WIND_MAX_PLAYBACK_SPEED - WIND_MIN_PLAYBACK_SPEED) * alpha
	end

	local step = 1 - math.exp(-WIND_LERP_SPEED * math.min(dt, 0.1))
	wind.Volume = wind.Volume + (targetVolume - wind.Volume) * step
	wind.PlaybackSpeed = wind.PlaybackSpeed + (targetPitch - wind.PlaybackSpeed) * step

	if not wind.IsPlaying then
		wind:Play()
	end
end

function AudioController.PlayWeaponSound(soundKey: string): ()
	ensurePoolsInitialized()

	local soundId = resolveWeaponSoundId(soundKey)
	if not soundId or soundId == "" or soundId == "rbxassetid://0" then
		return
	end

	weaponPoolCursor = (weaponPoolCursor % WEAPON_SOUND_POOL_SIZE) + 1
	local sound = weaponSoundPool[weaponPoolCursor]
	sound.SoundId = soundId
	sound.PlaybackSpeed = rng:NextNumber(0.97, 1.03)
	sound.TimePosition = 0
	sound:Play()
end

function AudioController.PlayUISound(soundKey: string): ()
	ensurePoolsInitialized()

	local soundId = resolveUISoundId(soundKey)
	if not soundId or soundId == "" or soundId == "rbxassetid://0" then
		return
	end

	uiPoolCursor = (uiPoolCursor % UI_SOUND_POOL_SIZE) + 1
	local sound = uiSoundPool[uiPoolCursor]
	sound.SoundId = soundId
	sound.PlaybackSpeed = 1
	sound.TimePosition = 0
	sound:Play()
end

function AudioController.Init(): ()
	if initialized then
		return
	end
	initialized = true

	ensurePoolsInitialized()

	local movementAny = MovementController :: any
	if type(movementAny.OnLandedCallbacks) == "table" then
		table.insert(movementAny.OnLandedCallbacks, playLandingThud)
	elseif type(movementAny.OnLanded) == "table" and type(movementAny.OnLanded.Connect) == "function" then
		movementAny.OnLanded:Connect(playLandingThud)
	end

	if renderConnection then
		renderConnection:Disconnect()
	end
	renderConnection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(updateWindRushAudio)
end

return table.freeze(AudioController)
````

## File: src/client/ui/LobbyApp.luau
````
--!strict
--[[
	LobbyApp.luau
	Sleek glassmorphic sci-fi pre-spawn Lobby / Loadout overlay.
	- Active when LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("InArena") ~= true or toggled via M / B keybind
	- Weapon selection: VORTEX_SMG or HELIOS_RAIL (dynamically synced with WeaponData.luau)
	- "Competitive 240FPS Mode" toggle
	- Live Top Server B-Hop Speed Records board reading player:GetAttribute("TopBhopSpeed")
	- "DEPLOY TO ARENA" button firing ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("RequestDeploy"):FireServer(selectedWeaponId)
]]

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local clientRoot = script.Parent.Parent

local MovementController = require(clientRoot:WaitForChild("movement"):WaitForChild("MovementController")) :: any

-- Shared WeaponData module lookup
local WeaponData: { [string]: any } = {}
do
	local sharedFolder = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Shared") or ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Shared", 5)
	if sharedFolder then
		local configs = sharedFolder:FindFirstChild("configs")
		local weaponDataModule = if configs then configs:FindFirstChild("WeaponData") else nil
		if weaponDataModule and weaponDataModule:IsA("ModuleScript") then
			local ok, mod = pcall(require, weaponDataModule)
			if ok and type(mod) == "table" then
				WeaponData = mod
			end
		end
	end
end

-- Optional GraphicsController & WeaponController bridges
local GraphicsController: any = nil
do
	local graphicsFolder = clientRoot:FindFirstChild("graphics")
	local gcModule = if graphicsFolder then graphicsFolder:FindFirstChild("GraphicsController") else nil
	if gcModule and gcModule:IsA("ModuleScript") then
		local ok, mod = pcall(require, gcModule)
		if ok then
			GraphicsController = mod
		end
	end
end

local WeaponController: any = nil
do
	local combatFolder = clientRoot:FindFirstChild("combat")
	local wcModule = if combatFolder then combatFolder:FindFirstChild("WeaponController") else nil
	if wcModule and wcModule:IsA("ModuleScript") then
		local ok, mod = pcall(require, wcModule)
		if ok then
			WeaponController = mod
		end
	end
end

local LobbyApp = {}

-- Palette & Styling Constants
local BG_OVERLAY_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(6, 9, 14)
local CARD_BG_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(10, 14, 20)
local CARD_TRANSPARENCY = 0.35
local COLOR_NEON_CYAN = Color3.fromRGB(0, 240, 255) -- #00F0FF
local COLOR_OVERDRIVE_ORANGE = Color3.fromRGB(255, 110, 0) -- #FF6E00
local COLOR_TEXT_MAIN = Color3.fromRGB(235, 248, 255)
local COLOR_TEXT_SUB = Color3.fromRGB(135, 160, 180)
local COLOR_BORDER_IDLE = Color3.fromRGB(45, 65, 85)

type WeaponOption = {
	Id: string,
	Title: string,
	Class: string,
	DefaultDmg: number,
	DefaultHs: number,
	DefaultRpm: number,
	DefaultMag: number,
	Description: string,
}

local WEAPON_OPTIONS: { WeaponOption } = {
	{
		Id = "VORTEX_SMG",
		Title = "VORTEX_SMG",
		Class = "PLASMA SUBMACHINE GUN // CQC-VELOCITY",
		DefaultDmg = 18,
		DefaultHs = 36,
		DefaultRpm = 720,
		DefaultMag = 30,
		Description = "High-cadence plasma repeater engineered for aggressive mid-air tracking at 45+ studs/s.",
	},
	{
		Id = "HELIOS_RAIL",
		Title = "HELIOS_RAIL",
		Class = "LINEAR ACCELERATOR RAILGUN // PRECISION",
		DefaultDmg = 95,
		DefaultHs = 237,
		DefaultRpm = 51,
		DefaultMag = 5,
		Description = "Instantaneous hyper-velocity slug projector rewarding pinpoint flick accuracy while B-hopping.",
	},
}

local FALLBACK_RECORDS = {
	{ Name = "AERO_VALKYRIE", Speed = 74.8 },
	{ Name = "PHANTOM_HZ", Speed = 68.4 },
	{ Name = "NEXUS_STRIDER", Speed = 63.1 },
	{ Name = "VORTEX_ZERO", Speed = 58.9 },
	{ Name = "KINETIC_PULSE", Speed = 52.5 },
}

-- State
local isInitialized = false
local lobbyGui: ScreenGui? = nil
local selectedWeaponId = "VORTEX_SMG"
local competitive240Mode = false
local manualOverlayOpen = false
local localPeakSpeed = 0.0

local weaponCardRefs: { [string]: { Card: Frame, Stroke: UIStroke, Badge: TextLabel, StatsLabel: TextLabel } } = {}
local recordRowLabels: { TextLabel } = {}
local toggleStrokeRef: UIStroke? = nil
local toggleStateLabelRef: TextLabel? = nil

local function buildWeaponStatsText(option: WeaponOption): string
	local entry = WeaponData[option.Id] or (WeaponData.Weapons and WeaponData.Weapons[option.Id])
	local dmg = option.DefaultDmg
	local hs = option.DefaultHs
	local rpm = option.DefaultRpm
	local mag = option.DefaultMag

	if type(entry) == "table" then
		local rawDmg = entry.BaseDamage or entry.Damage
		if type(rawDmg) == "number" then
			dmg = math.floor(rawDmg)
		end

		if type(entry.HeadshotDamage) == "number" then
			hs = math.floor(entry.HeadshotDamage)
		elseif type(entry.HeadshotMultiplier) == "number" then
			hs = math.floor(dmg * entry.HeadshotMultiplier)
		end

		if type(entry.FireRateRPM) == "number" then
			rpm = math.round(entry.FireRateRPM)
		elseif type(entry.RPM) == "number" then
			rpm = math.round(entry.RPM)
		elseif type(entry.FireInterval) == "number" and entry.FireInterval > 0 then
			rpm = math.round(60 / entry.FireInterval)
		elseif type(entry.FireCooldown) == "number" and entry.FireCooldown > 0 then
			rpm = math.round(60 / entry.FireCooldown)
		elseif type(entry.FireRate) == "number" and entry.FireRate > 0 then
			rpm = if entry.FireRate > 25 then math.round(entry.FireRate) else math.round(60 / entry.FireRate)
		end

		local rawMag = entry.MagazineSize or entry.MaxAmmo or entry.AmmoCapacity
		if type(rawMag) == "number" then
			mag = math.floor(rawMag)
		end
	end

	return string.format("DMG: %d (%d HS) | ROF: %d RPM | MAG: %02d", dmg, hs, rpm, mag)
end

local function styleGlassPanel(frame: GuiObject, strokeColor: Color3, strokeThickness: number?): UIStroke
	frame.BackgroundColor3 = CARD_BG_COLOR
	frame.BackgroundTransparency = CARD_TRANSPARENCY
	frame.BorderSizePixel = 0

	local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
	corner.Parent = frame

	local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	stroke.Color = strokeColor
	stroke.Thickness = strokeThickness or 1
	stroke.Transparency = 0.2
	stroke.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
	stroke.Parent = frame

	return stroke
end

local function updateWeaponSelectionVisuals()
	for _, option in ipairs(WEAPON_OPTIONS) do
		local refs = weaponCardRefs[option.Id]
		if refs then
			local isSelected = (option.Id == selectedWeaponId)
			refs.Stroke.Color = if isSelected then COLOR_NEON_CYAN else COLOR_BORDER_IDLE
			refs.Stroke.Thickness = if isSelected then 2 else 1
			refs.Card.BackgroundTransparency = if isSelected then 0.2 else CARD_TRANSPARENCY
			refs.Badge.Text = if isSelected then "SELECTED // ACTIVE" else "CLICK TO EQUIP"
			refs.Badge.TextColor3 = if isSelected then COLOR_NEON_CYAN else COLOR_TEXT_SUB
			refs.StatsLabel.Text = buildWeaponStatsText(option)
		end
	end

	LocalPlayer:SetAttribute("SelectedWeapon", selectedWeaponId)
	if type(WeaponController) == "table" and type(WeaponController.EquipWeapon) == "function" then
		pcall(WeaponController.EquipWeapon, selectedWeaponId)
	end
end

local function applyCompetitiveMode(enabled: boolean)
	competitive240Mode = enabled
	LocalPlayer:SetAttribute("Competitive240FPSMode", enabled)

	if toggleStrokeRef then
		toggleStrokeRef.Color = if enabled then COLOR_OVERDRIVE_ORANGE else COLOR_BORDER_IDLE
		toggleStrokeRef.Thickness = if enabled then 2 else 1
	end
	if toggleStateLabelRef then
		toggleStateLabelRef.Text = if enabled then "Competitive 240FPS Mode: ON" else "Competitive 240FPS Mode: OFF"
		toggleStateLabelRef.TextColor3 = if enabled then COLOR_OVERDRIVE_ORANGE else COLOR_TEXT_MAIN
	end

	if type(GraphicsController) == "table" then
		local tierName = if enabled then "COMPETITIVE_240FPS" else "HIGH_FIDELITY"
		if type(GraphicsController.SetCompetitiveMode) == "function" then
			pcall(GraphicsController.SetCompetitiveMode, enabled)
		elseif type(GraphicsController.SetQualityTier) == "function" then
			pcall(GraphicsController.SetQualityTier, tierName)
		elseif type(GraphicsController.ApplyTier) == "function" then
			pcall(GraphicsController.ApplyTier, tierName)
		end
	end
end

local function refreshSpeedRecords()
	if type(MovementController) == "table" and type(MovementController.CurrentPlanarSpeed) == "number" then
		if MovementController.CurrentPlanarSpeed > localPeakSpeed then
			localPeakSpeed = MovementController.CurrentPlanarSpeed
		end
	end

	local entries: { { Name: string, Speed: number } } = {}
	local seenNames: { [string]: boolean } = {}

	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		local attrSpeed = player:GetAttribute("TopBhopSpeed")
			or player:GetAttribute("PeakSpeed")
			or player:GetAttribute("TopSpeed")
			or player:GetAttribute("BestBhopSpeed")
			or player:GetAttribute("MaxSpeed")
		local speedVal = if type(attrSpeed) == "number" then attrSpeed else 0
		if player == LocalPlayer and localPeakSpeed > speedVal then
			speedVal = localPeakSpeed
		end
		if speedVal > 0 then
			table.insert(entries, { Name = string.upper(player.Name), Speed = speedVal })
			seenNames[string.upper(player.Name)] = true
		end
	end

	for _, fallback in ipairs(FALLBACK_RECORDS) do
		if not seenNames[fallback.Name] then
			table.insert(entries, { Name = fallback.Name, Speed = fallback.Speed })
		end
	end

	table.sort(entries, function(a, b)
		return a.Speed > b.Speed
	end)

	for i, rowLabel in ipairs(recordRowLabels) do
		local record = entries[i]
		if record then
			local isOverdrive = record.Speed > 45.0
			rowLabel.Text = string.format("#%d  %-16s %04.1f STUDS/S", i, record.Name, record.Speed)
			rowLabel.TextColor3 = if i == 1
				then COLOR_OVERDRIVE_ORANGE
				elseif isOverdrive then COLOR_NEON_CYAN
				else COLOR_TEXT_MAIN
		end
	end
end

local function syncLobbyState()
	local inArena = LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("InArena") == true
	local showLobby = (not inArena) or manualOverlayOpen

	if lobbyGui then
		lobbyGui.Enabled = showLobby
	end

	if showLobby then
		UserInputService.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.Default
		UserInputService.MouseIconEnabled = true
		updateWeaponSelectionVisuals()
		refreshSpeedRecords()
	else
		UserInputService.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.LockCenter
		UserInputService.MouseIconEnabled = false
	end
end

local function handleDeployClicked()
	manualOverlayOpen = false
	syncLobbyState()

	local requestDeploy = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("RequestDeploy", 5)
	if requestDeploy and requestDeploy:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
		requestDeploy:FireServer(selectedWeaponId)
	end
end

function LobbyApp.Init()
	if isInitialized then
		return
	end
	isInitialized = true

	local playerGui = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

	local screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
	screenGui.Name = "SciFiLobbyGui"
	screenGui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
	screenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
	screenGui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
	screenGui.DisplayOrder = 20
	screenGui.Parent = playerGui
	lobbyGui = screenGui

	-- Dim Glassmorphic Backdrop
	local backdrop = Instance.new("Frame")
	backdrop.Name = "LobbyBackdrop"
	backdrop.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	backdrop.BackgroundColor3 = BG_OVERLAY_COLOR
	backdrop.BackgroundTransparency = 0.25
	backdrop.BorderSizePixel = 0
	backdrop.Parent = screenGui

	-- Main Centered Container
	local mainPanel = Instance.new("Frame")
	mainPanel.Name = "MainContainer"
	mainPanel.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	mainPanel.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
	mainPanel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(820, 470)
	mainPanel.Parent = backdrop
	styleGlassPanel(mainPanel, COLOR_NEON_CYAN, 1)

	-- Header Banner
	local titleLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	titleLabel.Name = "HeaderTitle"
	titleLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	titleLabel.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(24, 18)
	titleLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -48, 0, 26)
	titleLabel.Font = Enum.Font.Code
	titleLabel.Text = "ORBITAL DROP // TACTICAL LOADOUT & TELEMETRY"
	titleLabel.TextSize = 20
	titleLabel.TextColor3 = COLOR_NEON_CYAN
	titleLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	titleLabel.Parent = mainPanel

	local subtitleLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	subtitleLabel.Name = "HeaderSubtitle"
	subtitleLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	subtitleLabel.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(24, 44)
	subtitleLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -48, 0, 16)
	subtitleLabel.Font = Enum.Font.Code
	subtitleLabel.Text = "SELECT PRIMARY ARMAMENT, CONFIGURE 240HZ PIPELINE, AND DEPLOY [KEYBIND: M / B]"
	subtitleLabel.TextSize = 12
	subtitleLabel.TextColor3 = COLOR_TEXT_SUB
	subtitleLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	subtitleLabel.Parent = mainPanel

	-- =========================================================================
	-- LEFT COLUMN: PRIMARY WEAPON SELECTION (VORTEX_SMG / HELIOS_RAIL)
	-- =========================================================================
	local loadoutHeader = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	loadoutHeader.Name = "LoadoutHeader"
	loadoutHeader.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	loadoutHeader.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(24, 76)
	loadoutHeader.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(440, 18)
	loadoutHeader.Font = Enum.Font.Code
	loadoutHeader.Text = "PRIMARY WEAPON SELECT"
	loadoutHeader.TextSize = 13
	loadoutHeader.TextColor3 = COLOR_TEXT_MAIN
	loadoutHeader.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	loadoutHeader.Parent = mainPanel

	for idx, weapon in ipairs(WEAPON_OPTIONS) do
		local yOffset = 100 + (idx - 1) * 130
		local card = Instance.new("Frame")
		card.Name = weapon.Id .. "_Card"
		card.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(24, yOffset)
		card.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(450, 118)
		card.Parent = mainPanel
		local stroke = styleGlassPanel(card, COLOR_BORDER_IDLE, 1)

		local nameLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		nameLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		nameLabel.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 10)
		nameLabel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(240, 22)
		nameLabel.Font = Enum.Font.Code
		nameLabel.Text = weapon.Title
		nameLabel.TextSize = 18
		nameLabel.TextColor3 = COLOR_TEXT_MAIN
		nameLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
		nameLabel.Parent = card

		local badge = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		badge.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		badge.Position = UDim2.new(1, -176, 0, 12)
		badge.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(160, 18)
		badge.Font = Enum.Font.Code
		badge.Text = "CLICK TO EQUIP"
		badge.TextSize = 12
		badge.TextColor3 = COLOR_TEXT_SUB
		badge.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
		badge.Parent = card

		local classLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		classLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		classLabel.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 34)
		classLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -32, 0, 16)
		classLabel.Font = Enum.Font.Code
		classLabel.Text = weapon.Class
		classLabel.TextSize = 11
		classLabel.TextColor3 = COLOR_NEON_CYAN
		classLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
		classLabel.Parent = card

		local statsLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		statsLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		statsLabel.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 54)
		statsLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -32, 0, 18)
		statsLabel.Font = Enum.Font.Code
		statsLabel.Text = buildWeaponStatsText(weapon)
		statsLabel.TextSize = 12
		statsLabel.TextColor3 = COLOR_OVERDRIVE_ORANGE
		statsLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
		statsLabel.Parent = card

		local descLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		descLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		descLabel.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 76)
		descLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -32, 0, 32)
		descLabel.Font = Enum.Font.Code
		descLabel.Text = weapon.Description
		descLabel.TextWrapped = true
		descLabel.TextSize = 11
		descLabel.TextColor3 = COLOR_TEXT_SUB
		descLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
		descLabel.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top
		descLabel.Parent = card

		local selectBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
		selectBtn.Name = "Select_" .. weapon.Id
		selectBtn.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
		selectBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		selectBtn.Text = ""
		selectBtn.Parent = card

		selectBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
			selectedWeaponId = weapon.Id
			updateWeaponSelectionVisuals()
		end)

		weaponCardRefs[weapon.Id] = {
			Card = card,
			Stroke = stroke,
			Badge = badge,
			StatsLabel = statsLabel,
		}
	end

	-- =========================================================================
	-- RIGHT COLUMN: TOP SERVER B-HOP SPEED RECORDS & 240FPS MODE TOGGLE
	-- =========================================================================
	local recordsHeader = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	recordsHeader.Name = "RecordsHeader"
	recordsHeader.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	recordsHeader.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(496, 76)
	recordsHeader.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(300, 18)
	recordsHeader.Font = Enum.Font.Code
	recordsHeader.Text = "TOP SERVER B-HOP SPEED RECORDS"
	recordsHeader.TextSize = 13
	recordsHeader.TextColor3 = COLOR_TEXT_MAIN
	recordsHeader.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	recordsHeader.Parent = mainPanel

	local recordsCard = Instance.new("Frame")
	recordsCard.Name = "RecordsBoard"
	recordsCard.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(496, 100)
	recordsCard.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(300, 180)
	recordsCard.Parent = mainPanel
	styleGlassPanel(recordsCard, COLOR_BORDER_IDLE, 1)

	table.clear(recordRowLabels)
	for i = 1, 5 do
		local row = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		row.Name = string.format("RecordRow_%d", i)
		row.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		row.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 12 + (i - 1) * 31)
		row.Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, 24)
		row.Font = Enum.Font.Code
		row.TextSize = 13
		row.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
		row.Parent = recordsCard
		table.insert(recordRowLabels, row)
	end

	-- Competitive 240FPS Mode Toggle Button
	local fpsToggleBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
	fpsToggleBtn.Name = "Competitive240Toggle"
	fpsToggleBtn.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(496, 294)
	fpsToggleBtn.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(300, 54)
	fpsToggleBtn.AutoButtonColor = false
	fpsToggleBtn.Text = ""
	fpsToggleBtn.Parent = mainPanel
	toggleStrokeRef = styleGlassPanel(fpsToggleBtn, COLOR_BORDER_IDLE, 1)

	local toggleTitle = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	toggleTitle.Name = "ToggleTitle"
	toggleTitle.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	toggleTitle.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 8)
	toggleTitle.Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, 20)
	toggleTitle.Font = Enum.Font.Code
	toggleTitle.Text = "Competitive 240FPS Mode: OFF"
	toggleTitle.TextSize = 14
	toggleTitle.TextColor3 = COLOR_TEXT_MAIN
	toggleTitle.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	toggleTitle.Parent = fpsToggleBtn
	toggleStateLabelRef = toggleTitle

	local toggleDesc = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	toggleDesc.Name = "ToggleSubtitle"
	toggleDesc.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	toggleDesc.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 29)
	toggleDesc.Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, 16)
	toggleDesc.Font = Enum.Font.Code
	toggleDesc.Text = "STRIPS POST-FX & SHADOWS FOR MINIMAL FRAME LATENCY"
	toggleDesc.TextSize = 10
	toggleDesc.TextColor3 = COLOR_TEXT_SUB
	toggleDesc.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	toggleDesc.Parent = fpsToggleBtn

	fpsToggleBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
		applyCompetitiveMode(not competitive240Mode)
	end)

	-- =========================================================================
	-- BOTTOM ACTION: DEPLOY TO ARENA BUTTON
	-- =========================================================================
	local deployBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
	deployBtn.Name = "DeployToArenaButton"
	deployBtn.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(24, 376)
	deployBtn.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(772, 66)
	deployBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(12, 28, 38)
	deployBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 0.15
	deployBtn.Font = Enum.Font.Code
	deployBtn.Text = "DEPLOY TO ARENA"
	deployBtn.TextSize = 22
	deployBtn.TextColor3 = COLOR_NEON_CYAN
	deployBtn.Parent = mainPanel

	local deployCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	deployCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
	deployCorner.Parent = deployBtn

	local deployStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	deployStroke.Color = COLOR_NEON_CYAN
	deployStroke.Thickness = 2
	deployStroke.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
	deployStroke.Parent = deployBtn

	deployBtn.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
		deployStroke.Color = COLOR_OVERDRIVE_ORANGE
		deployBtn.TextColor3 = COLOR_OVERDRIVE_ORANGE
	end)

	deployBtn.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
		deployStroke.Color = COLOR_NEON_CYAN
		deployBtn.TextColor3 = COLOR_NEON_CYAN
	end)

	deployBtn.Activated:Connect(handleDeployClicked)

	-- Keybind (M or B) to reopen/toggle Loadout overlay while in Arena
	UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input: InputObject, gameProcessed: boolean)
		if gameProcessed then
			return
		end
		if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.M or input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.B then
			if LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("InArena") == true then
				manualOverlayOpen = not manualOverlayOpen
				syncLobbyState()
			end
		end
	end)

	-- Initialize defaults & bind reactive listeners
	updateWeaponSelectionVisuals()
	applyCompetitiveMode(false)
	refreshSpeedRecords()

	LocalPlayer:GetAttributeChangedSignal("InArena"):Connect(function()
		if LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("InArena") == true then
			manualOverlayOpen = false
		end
		syncLobbyState()
	end)
	syncLobbyState()

	RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		if lobbyGui and lobbyGui.Enabled then
			refreshSpeedRecords()
		elseif type(MovementController) == "table" and type(MovementController.CurrentPlanarSpeed) == "number" then
			if MovementController.CurrentPlanarSpeed > localPeakSpeed then
				localPeakSpeed = MovementController.CurrentPlanarSpeed
			end
		end
	end)
end

return LobbyApp
````

## File: src/shared/configs/MapConfig.luau
````
--!strict
--[[
	MapConfig.luau
	Read-only arena map bounds, spawn points, jump pads, and bhop ramp surface parameters.
]]

export type JumpPadSpec = {
	Position: Vector3,
	Size: Vector3,
	LaunchVelocity: Vector3,
}

export type MapConfigType = {
	MapName: string,
	KillPlaneY: number,
	RespawnDelay: number,
	SpawnLocations: { CFrame },
	JumpPads: { JumpPadSpec },
}

local SpawnLocations: { CFrame } = table.freeze({
	CFrame.new(-80, 6, -80) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(-45), 0),
	CFrame.new(80, 6, -80) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(45), 0),
	CFrame.new(-80, 6, 80) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(-135), 0),
	CFrame.new(80, 6, 80) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(135), 0),
	CFrame.new(0, 18, -110) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, 0),
	CFrame.new(0, 18, 110) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(180), 0),
})

local JumpPads: { JumpPadSpec } = table.freeze({
	table.freeze({
		Position = Vector3.new(-48, 1.5, 0),
		Size = Vector3.new(10, 1, 10),
		LaunchVelocity = Vector3.new(38, 68, 0),
	}),
	table.freeze({
		Position = Vector3.new(48, 1.5, 0),
		Size = Vector3.new(10, 1, 10),
		LaunchVelocity = Vector3.new(-38, 68, 0),
	}),
})

local MapConfig: MapConfigType = {
	MapName = "Orbital_Bhop_Proving_Grounds",
	KillPlaneY = -120,
	RespawnDelay = 2.5,
	SpawnLocations = SpawnLocations,
	JumpPads = JumpPads,
}

return table.freeze(MapConfig)
````

## File: README.md
````markdown
# SCI-FI BHOP FPS — Architecture & AI Agent Context Guide

A production-grade, high-speed multiplayer First-Person Shooter (FPS) built on Roblox using `--!strict` Luau, Rojo 7, Rokit, and Wally. The core gameplay loop combines **Quake/Source-style bunny-hopping and air-strafing**, **procedural 3D spring viewmodels**, **client-predicted hitscan with 60Hz server-side hitbox rewind**, and a **minimalist glassmorphic sci-fi HUD**.

---

## 1. AI Coding Agent Rules & Guardrails (CRITICAL)

Every AI coding agent or contributor working in this repository MUST obey these rules:

1. **Strict Typing Mandatory:** Every `.luau` file MUST begin with `--!strict` on line 1. All function signatures, tables, and return types must be explicitly typed.
2. **BANNED Legacy Roblox APIs:**
   - NEVER use Roblox `Tool` instances or `Backpack` for weapons.
   - NEVER use default `Humanoid` movement braking (`Humanoid.EvaluateStateMachine` MUST remain `false` during active gameplay).
   - NEVER use `wait()`, `spawn()`, or `delay()` (always use `task.wait()`, `task.spawn()`, `task.delay()`).
   - NEVER use `Instance.new()` inside `RenderStepped` or firing loops (always use pre-allocated ring-buffer object pools like `TracerPool.luau`).
   - NEVER send tables or strings over `RemoteEvents` for high-frequency combat/movement packets (always serialize into raw Luau `buffer` objects).
3. **Strict 4-Pillar Separation of Concerns:**
   - Gameplay scripts inside `src/` MUST NEVER contain hardcoded `rbxassetid://` strings, raw lighting values, or direct folder traversal.
   - All 3D models, audio, and sprites are queried exclusively through `src/shared/configs/AssetRegistry.luau`.
   - All animation IDs, priorities, and fade times are queried exclusively through `animations/registry/init.luau`.
   - All lighting, post-processing, and FOV presets live exclusively in `graphics/presets/LightingProfile.luau`.

---

## 2. Master Repository Architecture (The 4 Pillars)

The repository is split into four root domains mapped into Roblox Studio via `default.project.json`:

```text
scifi-bhop-fps/
├── rokit.toml                          # Toolchain: Rojo 7.4.4, Wally, StyLua, Selene
├── wally.toml                          # Dependencies: sleitnick/trove, sleitnick/signal
├── default.project.json                # Rojo DataModel synchronization tree
│
├── assets/                             # [PILLAR 1: 3D MODELS, AUDIO & UI SPRITES]
│   ├── models/
│   │   ├── viewmodels/                 # 1P rigs (.rbxm) -> ReplicatedStorage.Assets.Models.viewmodels
│   │   ├── worldmodels/                # 3P meshes (.rbxm) -> ReplicatedStorage.Assets.Models.worldmodels
│   │   └── characters/                 # Competitive R6 rig (.rbxm)
│   ├── audio/                          # Raw .ogg files (weapons, movement, UI)
│   └── ui_sprites/                     # Raw .png reticles and weapon icons
│
├── animations/                         # [PILLAR 2: ANIMATIONS & KEYFRAME REGISTRIES]
│   ├── blender_source/                 # Source .blend / .fbx files (ignored by Rojo)
│   ├── exported_rbxm/                  # KeyframeSequence backups (.rbxm)
│   └── registry/                       # Synced -> ReplicatedStorage.Animations
│       ├── init.luau                   # Master AnimationRegistry module
│       ├── ViewmodelAnims.luau         # 1P weapon idle, equip, reload, inspect tracks
│       └── CharacterAnims.luau         # 3P R6 slide, air-strafe tuck, locomotion tracks
│
├── graphics/                           # [PILLAR 3: LIGHTING, PBR MATERIALS & VFX PREFABS]
│   ├── vfx_prefabs/                    # Synced -> ReplicatedStorage.Graphics.VFX (.rbxm)
│   │   ├── PlasmaTracerBeam.rbxm       # Pooled beam tracer template
│   │   ├── MuzzleFlashSciFi.rbxm       # Muzzle particle prefab
│   │   └── ImpactSparks.rbxm           # Surface hit spark prefab
│   ├── materials/                      # Synced -> MaterialService.CustomMaterials (.rbxm)
│   └── presets/                        # Synced -> ReplicatedStorage.Graphics.Presets
│       ├── LightingProfile.luau        # Future lighting, Bloom, ColorCorrection, FOV warp
│       └── GraphicsQualityTiers.luau   # Competitive Low (240+ FPS) vs Ultra Sci-Fi presets
│
└── src/                                # [PILLAR 4: PURE LUAU GAMEPLAY LOGIC]
    ├── client/                         # Synced -> StarterPlayer.StarterPlayerScripts.Client
    │   ├── init.client.luau            # Client bootstrapper
    │   ├── movement/
    │   │   ├── MovementController.luau # Quake air-strafe, auto-bhop, and ground friction math
    │   │   └── SlideController.luau    # Slide impulse, low-friction decay, camera crouch offset
    │   ├── combat/
    │   │   ├── WeaponController.luau   # Input state machine, client raycast, 28B buffer sender
    │   │   └── TracerPool.luau         # 50-instance zero-GC ring buffer for PlasmaTracerBeam
    │   ├── viewmodel/
    │   │   ├── ViewmodelController.luau# RenderStepped camera bind, AimPart ADS lerp, 3D Springs
    │   │   └── AnimatorBridge.luau     # AnimationTrack loader for viewmodel Motor6Ds
    │   ├── graphics/
    │   │   ├── GraphicsController.luau # Applies LightingProfile + B-hop velocity FOV scaling
    │   │   └── VFXController.luau      # Muzzle flash & impact particle dispatcher
    │   └── ui/
    │       ├── HudApp.luau             # Minimalist sci-fi glassmorphic HUD & STUDS/S telemetry
    │       └── CrosshairModule.luau    # Velocity-reactive dynamic reticle
    │
    ├── server/                         # Synced -> ServerScriptService.Server
    │   ├── init.server.luau            # Server bootstrapper
    │   ├── combat/
    │   │   ├── HitboxHistory.luau      # 60Hz 1-second circular buffer of player part CFrames
    │   │   └── CombatValidator.luau    # Unpacks 28B shot buffer, rewinds hitboxes, applies damage
    │   └── replication/
    │       └── StanceReplicator.luau   # UnreliableRemoteEvent buffer sync for 3P look pitch/slide
    │
    └── shared/                         # Synced -> ReplicatedStorage.Shared
        ├── configs/
        │   ├── WeaponData.luau         # Read-only stats: RPM, damage, headshot mult, recoil kick
        │   ├── MovementConfig.luau     # Read-only physics constants: AirAccelerate, speed caps
        │   └── AssetRegistry.luau      # Single source of truth for Models, Audio, and Sprites
        ├── math/
        │   ├── Spring.luau             # 3D Hooke's Law damped harmonic oscillator (8x substepped)
        │   └── QuakeMath.luau          # Shared vector projection accelerate() & applyFriction()
        └── network/
            └── ShotPacket.luau         # 28-byte binary buffer serializer/deserializer
```

---

## 3. Core Systems Specifications

### 3.1 Custom Bunny-Hop & Air-Strafe Physics (`MovementController.luau`)
* **State Machine Bypass:** Sets `Humanoid.EvaluateStateMachine = false` every frame and drives `HumanoidRootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity` directly.
* **Ground Detection:** Casts a downward ray of length `MovementConfig.GroundRayLength` (`3.4` studs) from `HumanoidRootPart.Position` excluding the local character.
* **Frame-Perfect Auto-Bhop:** Holding `Space` sets `jumpQueued = true`. If `IsGrounded` transitions to `true` while `jumpQueued == true`, vertical velocity is immediately set to `JumpVelocity` (`42` studs/s) and `IsGrounded` is forced `false` on the exact landing frame—completely bypassing `applyFriction()`.
* **Quake Air Acceleration:** Mid-air velocity projection uses `currentVel:Dot(wishDir)` capped against `MaxAirWishSpeed` (`6.5`) with `AirAccelerate` (`120`), allowing players to smoothly gain horizontal momentum up to `HardSpeedCap` (`85` studs/s) by turning the camera into their strafe key (`A`/`D`).
* **Slide-Hopping:** Pressing `LeftControl` or `C` above `MinSlideSpeed` (`26` studs/s) applies a forward `SlideBoostImpulse` (`16` studs/s) and drops ground friction from `6.0` to `1.2`.

### 3.2 First-Person Viewmodel & Procedural Springs (`ViewmodelController.luau`)
* **Render Priority:** Bound via `RunService:BindToRenderStep` at `Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 1` to eliminate 1-frame camera lag.
* **3D Harmonic Springs (`Spring.luau`):**
  - `swaySpring`: Tracks mouse delta (`UserInputService:GetMouseDelta()`) for rotational weapon lag.
  - `recoilSpring`: Receives 3D impulse kicks (`Pitch`, `Yaw`, `Roll/Pushback`) per shot from `WeaponData`.
  - `movementSpring`: Receives downward velocity impulses from `MovementController.OnLandedCallbacks` proportional to vertical landing speed.
* **Mathematical ADS Alignment:** Never uses hardcoded ADS CFrame offsets. Computes the relative offset dynamically using `local aimOffset = aimPart.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(activeViewmodel.PrimaryPart.CFrame)` and interpolates `baseCFrame:Lerp(Camera.CFrame * aimOffset, adsAlpha)`.
* **Air-Strafe Roll Tilt:** Smoothly tilts the weapon roll angle (`±4.5°` on `A`/`D` strafe, `-8°` during slides).

### 3.3 Binary Buffer Networking & Lag-Compensated Hit Registration
* **28-Byte Shot Packet Schema (`ShotPacket.luau`):**
  - `Offset 00..07` (`f64` - 8 bytes): Client firing timestamp from `workspace:GetServerTimeNow()`.
  - `Offset 08..19` (`f32 x 3` - 12 bytes): Ray origin vector (`Origin.X`, `Origin.Y`, `Origin.Z`).
  - `Offset 20..27` (`f32 x 2` - 8 bytes): Ray orientation angles (`Pitch`, `Yaw` in radians).
* **Server Validation Pipeline (`CombatValidator.luau`):**
  1. Verifies `typeof(packet) == "buffer"` and `buffer.len(packet) == 28`.
  2. Checks rate-of-fire interval against `(60 / stats.FireRateRPM) * 0.88`.
  3. Validates origin distance against `shooterHead.Position` (max `14` studs tolerance to account for `85` studs/s bunny-hop speed).
  4. Clamps target rewind time to `[serverNow - 0.45, serverNow]`.
  5. Temporarily rewinds all enemy character `BasePart` CFrames using the 60Hz snapshot ring buffer (`HitboxHistory.luau`), executes `workspace:Raycast()`, immediately restores current CFrames, and applies damage.

### 3.4 Sci-Fi Minimalist HUD & Graphics (`HudApp.luau` & `GraphicsController.luau`)
* **Telemetry Panel:** Glassmorphic dark slate container (`Color3.fromRGB(10, 14, 20)`, `BackgroundTransparency = 0.35`) with a `1px` `UIStroke` and live `STUDS/S` digital readout.
* **Overdrive Color Shift:** Telemetry bar and border glow Neon Cyan (`#00F0FF`) during standard movement (`<= 45` studs/s) and shift to Overdrive Neon Orange (`#FF6E00`) when chaining bunny-hops above `45` studs/s.
* **Velocity FOV Warp:** Camera `FieldOfView` scales smoothly from `85` (at base walk speed) up to `103` (at max bunny-hop speed).

---

## 4. 3D Asset & Rig Conventions

Every weapon model exported into `assets/models/viewmodels/` MUST adhere to this exact hierarchy:
* `vm_[weapon_id]` (`Model` with `PrimaryPart` set to `RootPart`)
  * `RootPart` (`Part`, `Anchored = false`, `CanCollide = false`, `Transparency = 1`)
  * `LeftArm` & `RightArm` (`MeshPart`, `CanCollide = false`, rigged to `RootPart` via `Motor6D`)
  * `WeaponMesh` (`MeshPart`, `CanCollide = false`, rigged to `RootPart` via `Motor6D`)
    * `AimPart` (`BasePart` or `Attachment` centered directly on the optic reticle axis)
    * `MuzzleAttachment` (`Attachment` positioned at the barrel tip, `-Z` facing forward)
    * `ShellEjectAttachment` (`Attachment` positioned at the ejection port)

---

## 5. Development Workflow & CLI Commands

```bash
# 1. Install toolchain binaries (Rojo, Wally, StyLua, Selene)
rokit install

# 2. Install Wally package dependencies into /Packages
wally install

# 3. Start Rojo live-sync server with Roblox Studio
rojo serve default.project.json

# 4. Run static analysis & formatting before committing
selene src/
stylua --check src/
```

## File: src/client/combat/TracerPool.luau
````
--!strict
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local POOL_SIZE = 50
local TRACER_LIFETIME = 0.08
local DEFAULT_WIDTH_0 = 0.14
local DEFAULT_WIDTH_1 = 0.24
local OVERDRIVE_WIDTH_MULTIPLIER = 1.65

local STANDARD_COLOR = ColorSequence.new({
	ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(180, 250, 255)),
	ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(0, 225, 255)),
})

local OVERDRIVE_COLOR = ColorSequence.new({
	ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(255, 210, 255)),
	ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(255, 55, 215)),
})

type PooledTracer = {
	attachment0: Attachment,
	attachment1: Attachment,
	beam: Beam,
	active: boolean,
	elapsed: number,
	initialWidth0: number,
	initialWidth1: number,
}

local TracerPool = {}

local pool: { PooledTracer } = table.create(POOL_SIZE)
local nextPoolIndex = 1
local isInitialized = false
local renderConnection: RBXScriptConnection? = nil

local function resolveBeamTemplate(): Beam?
	local graphicsFolder = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Graphics")
	if not graphicsFolder then
		return nil
	end

	local vfxFolder = graphicsFolder:FindFirstChild("VFXPrefabs") or graphicsFolder:FindFirstChild("VFX")
	if not vfxFolder then
		return nil
	end

	local candidate = vfxFolder:FindFirstChild("PlasmaTracerBeam")
	if candidate and candidate:IsA("Beam") then
		return candidate
	end

	return nil
end

local function createProceduralBeam(index: number, template: Beam?): Beam
	if template then
		local cloned = template:Clone()
		cloned.Name = string.format("PlasmaTracerBeam_%d", index)
		cloned.Enabled = false
		return cloned
	end

	local beam = Instance.new("Beam")
	beam.Name = string.format("PlasmaTracerBeam_%d", index)
	beam.FaceCamera = true
	beam.LightEmission = 1
	beam.LightInfluence = 0
	beam.Brightness = 4
	beam.Segments = 1
	beam.Color = STANDARD_COLOR
	beam.Width0 = DEFAULT_WIDTH_0
	beam.Width1 = DEFAULT_WIDTH_1
	beam.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0)
	beam.Enabled = false
	return beam
end

local function stepTracers(dt: number)
	for i = 1, #pool do
		local entry = pool[i]
		if entry.active then
			local elapsed = entry.elapsed + dt
			entry.elapsed = elapsed

			if elapsed >= TRACER_LIFETIME then
				entry.active = false
				entry.beam.Enabled = false
			else
				local alpha = math.clamp(elapsed / TRACER_LIFETIME, 0, 1)
				local invAlpha = 1 - alpha
				entry.beam.Width0 = entry.initialWidth0 * invAlpha
				entry.beam.Width1 = entry.initialWidth1 * invAlpha
				entry.beam.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(alpha)
			end
		end
	end
end

function TracerPool.Init()
	if isInitialized then
		return
	end
	isInitialized = true

	local terrain = workspace.Terrain
	local beamTemplate = resolveBeamTemplate()

	for i = 1, POOL_SIZE do
		local attachment0 = Instance.new("Attachment")
		attachment0.Name = string.format("A0_%d", i)
		attachment0.Parent = terrain

		local attachment1 = Instance.new("Attachment")
		attachment1.Name = string.format("A1_%d", i)
		attachment1.Parent = terrain

		local beam = createProceduralBeam(i, beamTemplate)
		beam.Attachment0 = attachment0
		beam.Attachment1 = attachment1
		beam.Parent = terrain

		pool[i] = {
			attachment0 = attachment0,
			attachment1 = attachment1,
			beam = beam,
			active = false,
			elapsed = 0,
			initialWidth0 = beam.Width0 > 0 and beam.Width0 or DEFAULT_WIDTH_0,
			initialWidth1 = beam.Width1 > 0 and beam.Width1 or DEFAULT_WIDTH_1,
		}
	end

	renderConnection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(stepTracers)
end

function TracerPool.SpawnTracer(startPos: Vector3, endPos: Vector3, isOverdrive: boolean)
	if not isInitialized then
		TracerPool.Init()
	end

	local entry = pool[nextPoolIndex]
	nextPoolIndex = (nextPoolIndex % POOL_SIZE) + 1

	if not entry then
		return
	end

	local widthScale = if isOverdrive then OVERDRIVE_WIDTH_MULTIPLIER else 1.0
	local width0 = DEFAULT_WIDTH_0 * widthScale
	local width1 = DEFAULT_WIDTH_1 * widthScale

	entry.attachment0.WorldPosition = startPos
	entry.attachment1.WorldPosition = endPos

	entry.initialWidth0 = width0
	entry.initialWidth1 = width1
	entry.elapsed = 0
	entry.active = true

	local beam = entry.beam
	beam.Color = if isOverdrive then OVERDRIVE_COLOR else STANDARD_COLOR
	beam.Width0 = width0
	beam.Width1 = width1
	beam.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0)
	beam.Enabled = true
end

return TracerPool
````

## File: src/client/combat/WeaponController.luau
````
--!strict
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local Shared = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Shared")
