		WeaponId = 2,
		MaxAmmo = 5,
		MagazineSize = 5,
		ReloadTime = 2.1,
		FireRate = 0.85,
		Automatic = false,
		MaxRange = 1200,
		RecoilKick = Vector3.new(0.16, 0.03, 0.55),
		RecoilKickPos = Vector3.new(0, 0.02, 0.55),
		RecoilKickRot = Vector3.new(0.16, 0.03, 0),
		FireSoundKey = "RailgunFire",
		ReloadSoundKey = "PulseRifleReload",
		IsOverdrive = true,
	},
}

local WeaponController = {
	CurrentWeaponId = DEFAULT_WEAPON_ID,
	CurrentAmmo = 30,
	MaxAmmo = 30,
	IsReloading = false,
	OnHitConfirmed = {} :: { (isHeadshot: boolean) -> () },
	OnWeaponFired = {} :: { () -> () },
}

local isInitialized = false
local isTriggerHeld = false
local lastFireTimestamp = 0
local reloadStateToken = 0
local fireWeaponRemote: Instance? = nil

local pendingOptimisticHits = 0
local lastOptimisticHitTime = 0

local raycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
raycastParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
raycastParams.IgnoreWater = true

local filterInstances: { Instance } = table.create(4)

local function getWeaponStats(weaponId: string): WeaponStats
	local dataTable = WeaponData :: any
	if type(dataTable) == "table" then
		if type(dataTable.GetWeapon) == "function" then
			local result = dataTable.GetWeapon(weaponId)
			if result then
				return result
			end
		end
		if type(dataTable.Weapons) == "table" and dataTable.Weapons[weaponId] then
			return dataTable.Weapons[weaponId]
		end
		if dataTable[weaponId] then
			return dataTable[weaponId]
		end
	end

	return FALLBACK_WEAPON_STATS[weaponId] or FALLBACK_WEAPON_STATS[DEFAULT_WEAPON_ID]
end

local function getMaxAmmo(stats: WeaponStats): number
	return stats.MaxAmmo or stats.MagazineSize or 30
end

local function getReloadTime(stats: WeaponStats): number
	return stats.ReloadTime or 1.5
end

local function getMaxRange(stats: WeaponStats): number
	return stats.MaxRange or stats.Range or 800
end

local function getFireInterval(stats: WeaponStats): number
	if stats.FireInterval and stats.FireInterval > 0 then
		return stats.FireInterval
	end

	local fireRate = stats.FireRate
	if fireRate and fireRate > 0 then
		if fireRate > 40 then
			return 60 / fireRate
		end
		return 1 / fireRate
	end

	return 0.1
end

local function isWeaponAutomatic(weaponId: string, stats: WeaponStats): boolean
	if stats.Automatic ~= nil then
		return stats.Automatic
	end
	return weaponId == "VORTEX_SMG"
end

local function fireWeaponListeners()
	for i = 1, #WeaponController.OnWeaponFired do
		local callback = WeaponController.OnWeaponFired[i]
		if callback then
			callback()
		end
	end
end

local function fireHitListeners(isHeadshot: boolean)
	for i = 1, #WeaponController.OnHitConfirmed do
		local callback = WeaponController.OnHitConfirmed[i]
		if callback then
			callback(isHeadshot)
		end
	end
end

local function triggerHitmarkerFeedback(isHeadshot: boolean)
	CrosshairModule.TriggerHitmarker(isHeadshot)
	AudioController.PlayUISound(if isHeadshot then "HitmarkerHeadshot" else "HitmarkerBody")
	fireHitListeners(isHeadshot)
end

local function handleServerHitConfirm(payload: any)
	local isHeadshot = (typeof(payload) == "table" and payload.isHeadshot == true) or payload == true

	local now = os.clock()
	if pendingOptimisticHits > 0 and (now - lastOptimisticHitTime) <= OPTIMISTIC_HIT_DEDUP_WINDOW then
		pendingOptimisticHits -= 1
		return
	end

	pendingOptimisticHits = 0
	triggerHitmarkerFeedback(isHeadshot)
end

local function evaluateHitResult(rayResult: RaycastResult?): (boolean, boolean)
	if not rayResult or not rayResult.Instance then
		return false, false
	end

	local hitPart = rayResult.Instance
	local model = hitPart:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
	if not model then
		return false, false
	end

	if LOCAL_PLAYER and model == LOCAL_PLAYER.Character then
		return false, false
	end

	local humanoid = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local hasHitboxTag = hitPart:GetAttribute("IsHitbox") == true or model:GetAttribute("IsTarget") == true
	if not humanoid and not hasHitboxTag then
		return false, false
	end

	if humanoid and humanoid.Health <= 0 then
		return false, false
	end

	local partName = string.lower(hitPart.Name)
	local isHeadshot = partName == "head" or string.find(partName, "head", 1, true) ~= nil
	return true, isHeadshot
end

local function sendShotBuffer(packetBuffer: buffer)
	local remote = fireWeaponRemote
	if not remote then
		return
	end

	if remote:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
		remote:FireServer(packetBuffer)
	elseif remote:IsA("UnreliableRemoteEvent") then
		remote:FireServer(packetBuffer)
	end
end

local function startReload()
	if WeaponController.IsReloading then
		return
	end

	if WeaponController.CurrentAmmo >= WeaponController.MaxAmmo then
		return
	end

	local stats = getWeaponStats(WeaponController.CurrentWeaponId)
	local reloadDuration = getReloadTime(stats)

	WeaponController.IsReloading = true
	reloadStateToken += 1
	local activeToken = reloadStateToken

	local reloadRemote = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("ReloadWeaponEvent")
	if reloadRemote and reloadRemote:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
		reloadRemote:FireServer()
	end

	AudioController.PlayWeaponSound(stats.ReloadSoundKey or "PulseRifleReload")
	ViewmodelController.PlayReloadAnimation(reloadDuration)

	task.delay(reloadDuration, function()
		if reloadStateToken ~= activeToken or not WeaponController.IsReloading then
			return
		end

		WeaponController.CurrentAmmo = WeaponController.MaxAmmo
		WeaponController.IsReloading = false
	end)
end

local function attemptFire()
	if LOCAL_PLAYER and LOCAL_PLAYER:GetAttribute("InArena") ~= true then
		return
	end

	if WeaponController.IsReloading then
		return
	end

	if WeaponController.CurrentAmmo <= 0 then
		startReload()
		return
	end

	local weaponId = WeaponController.CurrentWeaponId
	local stats = getWeaponStats(weaponId)
	local fireInterval = getFireInterval(stats)

	local now = os.clock()
	if now - lastFireTimestamp < fireInterval then
		return
	end

	local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	if not camera then
		return
	end

	lastFireTimestamp = now
	WeaponController.CurrentAmmo = math.max(0, WeaponController.CurrentAmmo - 1)

	-- Update zero-allocation exclusion table for client-predicted raycast
	table.clear(filterInstances)
	if LOCAL_PLAYER and LOCAL_PLAYER.Character then
		table.insert(filterInstances, LOCAL_PLAYER.Character)
	end
	table.insert(filterInstances, camera)
	raycastParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = filterInstances

	local cameraCFrame = camera.CFrame
	local rayOrigin = cameraCFrame.Position
	local aimDirection = cameraCFrame.LookVector
	local maxRange = getMaxRange(stats)

	local rayResult = workspace:Raycast(rayOrigin, aimDirection * maxRange, raycastParams)
	local endPos = if rayResult then rayResult.Position else (rayOrigin + aimDirection * maxRange)

	AudioController.PlayWeaponSound(
		stats.FireSoundKey or (if weaponId == "HELIOS_RAIL" then "RailgunFire" else "PulseRifleFire")
	)

	local muzzleAtt = ViewmodelController.GetMuzzleAttachment()
	if muzzleAtt then
		VFXController.EmitMuzzleFlash(muzzleAtt)
	end

	local muzzlePos = rayOrigin
	if type((ViewmodelController :: any).GetMuzzleWorldPosition) == "function" then
		local resolvedMuzzle = ViewmodelController.GetMuzzleWorldPosition()
		if typeof(resolvedMuzzle) == "Vector3" then
			muzzlePos = resolvedMuzzle
		end
	elseif muzzleAtt then
		muzzlePos = muzzleAtt.WorldPosition
	end

	local isOverdrive = stats.IsOverdrive == true or weaponId == "HELIOS_RAIL"
	TracerPool.SpawnTracer(muzzlePos, endPos, isOverdrive)

	if rayResult then
		VFXController.SpawnImpactSparks(rayResult.Position, rayResult.Normal)
	end

	local recoilKickPos = stats.RecoilKickPos or stats.RecoilKick or Vector3.new(0, 0, 0.2)
	local recoilKickRot = stats.RecoilKickRot or Vector3.new(0.05, 0, 0)
	ViewmodelController.ApplyRecoilImpulse(recoilKickPos, recoilKickRot)

	local netTimestamp = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
	local unitDir = aimDirection.Unit
	local pitch = math.asin(math.clamp(unitDir.Y, -1, 1))
	local yaw = math.atan2(-unitDir.X, -unitDir.Z)
	local packetBuffer = ShotPacket.Encode(netTimestamp, rayOrigin, pitch, yaw)
	sendShotBuffer(packetBuffer)

	fireWeaponListeners()

	local didHitTarget, isHeadshot = evaluateHitResult(rayResult)
	if didHitTarget then
		pendingOptimisticHits += 1
		lastOptimisticHitTime = now
		triggerHitmarkerFeedback(isHeadshot)
	end

	if WeaponController.CurrentAmmo <= 0 then
		startReload()
	end
end

function WeaponController.SwitchWeapon(weaponId: string)
	if weaponId ~= "VORTEX_SMG" and weaponId ~= "HELIOS_RAIL" then
		local dataTable = WeaponData :: any
		if
			type(dataTable) ~= "table"
			or (not dataTable[weaponId] and not (dataTable.Weapons and dataTable.Weapons[weaponId]))
		then
			return
		end
	end

	reloadStateToken += 1
	WeaponController.IsReloading = false
	WeaponController.CurrentWeaponId = weaponId

	local stats = getWeaponStats(weaponId)
	local maxAmmo = getMaxAmmo(stats)
	WeaponController.MaxAmmo = maxAmmo
	WeaponController.CurrentAmmo = maxAmmo
	lastFireTimestamp = 0

	local vmController = ViewmodelController :: any
	if type(vmController.EquipWeapon) == "function" then
		vmController.EquipWeapon(weaponId)
	elseif type(vmController.SwitchWeapon) == "function" then
		vmController.SwitchWeapon(weaponId)
	elseif type(vmController.SetWeapon) == "function" then
		vmController.SetWeapon(weaponId)
	end
end

function WeaponController.Init()
	if isInitialized then
		return
	end
	isInitialized = true

	TracerPool.Init()
	fireWeaponRemote = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("FireWeaponBuffer")

	local hitConfirmRemote = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("HitConfirmEvent")
		or ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("HitConfirmed")
		or ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("HitConfirmEvent")

	if hitConfirmRemote and hitConfirmRemote:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
		hitConfirmRemote.OnClientEvent:Connect(handleServerHitConfirm)
	end

	local fallbackHitRemote = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("HitConfirmed")
	if fallbackHitRemote and fallbackHitRemote ~= hitConfirmRemote and fallbackHitRemote:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
		fallbackHitRemote.OnClientEvent:Connect(handleServerHitConfirm)
	end

	local initialWeapon = if LOCAL_PLAYER then LOCAL_PLAYER:GetAttribute("SelectedWeapon") else nil
	if type(initialWeapon) == "string" and initialWeapon ~= "" then
		WeaponController.SwitchWeapon(initialWeapon)
	else
		WeaponController.SwitchWeapon(DEFAULT_WEAPON_ID)
	end

	if LOCAL_PLAYER then
		LOCAL_PLAYER:GetAttributeChangedSignal("SelectedWeapon"):Connect(function()
			local selected = LOCAL_PLAYER:GetAttribute("SelectedWeapon")
			if type(selected) == "string" and selected ~= "" then
				WeaponController.SwitchWeapon(selected)
			end
		end)

		LOCAL_PLAYER:GetAttributeChangedSignal("InArena"):Connect(function()
			if LOCAL_PLAYER:GetAttribute("InArena") ~= true then
				isTriggerHeld = false
			end
		end)
	end

	UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input: InputObject, gameProcessedEvent: boolean)
		if gameProcessedEvent then
			return
		end

		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
			isTriggerHeld = true
			attemptFire()
		elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.One then
			WeaponController.SwitchWeapon("VORTEX_SMG")
		elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Two then
			WeaponController.SwitchWeapon("HELIOS_RAIL")
		elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.R then
			startReload()
		end
	end)

	UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input: InputObject)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
			isTriggerHeld = false
		end
	end)

	RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
		if not isTriggerHeld then
			return
		end

		local weaponId = WeaponController.CurrentWeaponId
		local stats = getWeaponStats(weaponId)
		if isWeaponAutomatic(weaponId, stats) then
			attemptFire()
		end
	end)
end

return WeaponController
````

## File: src/client/graphics/GraphicsController.luau
````
--!strict
--[[
	GraphicsController.luau
	Applies declarative cold sci-fi lighting presets, toggles Competitive (Low) vs Ultra (High)
	rendering tiers, and interpolates Camera.FieldOfView between 85 and 103 based on B-hop
	planar velocity (or compresses down to WeaponData.ADSFov when aiming down sights).
]]

local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local PresetsFolder = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Graphics"):WaitForChild("Presets")
local GraphicsQualityTiers = require(PresetsFolder:WaitForChild("GraphicsQualityTiers"))
local LightingProfile = require(PresetsFolder:WaitForChild("LightingProfile"))
local PostProcessing = require(PresetsFolder:WaitForChild("PostProcessing"))

local SharedConfigs = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Shared"):WaitForChild("configs")
local WeaponData = require(SharedConfigs:WaitForChild("WeaponData"))

local MovementController = require(script.Parent.Parent:WaitForChild("movement"):WaitForChild("MovementController"))

local WeaponController: any = nil
task.defer(function()
	local combatFolder = script.Parent.Parent:FindFirstChild("combat")
	local weaponModule = if combatFolder then combatFolder:FindFirstChild("WeaponController") else nil
	if weaponModule and weaponModule:IsA("ModuleScript") then
		local ok, result = pcall(require, weaponModule)
		if ok then
			WeaponController = result
		end
	end
end)

local BASE_FOV = PostProcessing.BaseFOV -- 85
local MAX_SPEED_FOV_BOOST = PostProcessing.MaxSpeedFOVBoost -- 18
local MAX_FOV = BASE_FOV + MAX_SPEED_FOV_BOOST -- 103
local FOV_SPEED_THRESHOLD = PostProcessing.FOVSpeedThreshold
local FOV_MAX_SPEED_REF = PostProcessing.FOVMaxSpeedReference
local FOV_LERP_SPEED = PostProcessing.FOVLerpSpeed

local initialized = false
local isCompetitiveLow = false
local currentTier = GraphicsQualityTiers.High

local atmosphereInstance: Atmosphere? = nil
local bloomInstance: BloomEffect? = nil
local colorCorrectionInstance: ColorCorrectionEffect? = nil
local depthOfFieldInstance: DepthOfFieldEffect? = nil
local sunRaysInstance: SunRaysEffect? = nil
local fovConnection: RBXScriptConnection? = nil

local GraphicsController = {}

local function getOrCreateEffect<T>(className: string, name: string): T
	local existing = Lighting:FindFirstChild(name)
	if existing and existing.ClassName == className then
		return (existing :: any) :: T
	end

	local created = Instance.new(className)
	created.Name = name
	created.Parent = Lighting
	return (created :: any) :: T
end

local function applyBaseLightingProfile(): ()
	Lighting.Ambient = LightingProfile.Ambient
	Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = LightingProfile.OutdoorAmbient
	Lighting.ColorShift_Top = LightingProfile.ColorShift_Top
	Lighting.ColorShift_Bottom = LightingProfile.ColorShift_Bottom
	Lighting.Brightness = LightingProfile.Brightness
	Lighting.ClockTime = LightingProfile.ClockTime
	Lighting.GeographicLatitude = LightingProfile.GeographicLatitude
	Lighting.EnvironmentDiffuseScale = LightingProfile.EnvironmentDiffuseScale
	Lighting.EnvironmentSpecularScale = LightingProfile.EnvironmentSpecularScale
	Lighting.ExposureCompensation = LightingProfile.ExposureCompensation
	Lighting.GlobalShadows = LightingProfile.GlobalShadows
	Lighting.ShadowSoftness = LightingProfile.ShadowSoftness
	Lighting.FogColor = LightingProfile.FogColor
	Lighting.FogStart = LightingProfile.FogStart
	Lighting.FogEnd = LightingProfile.FogEnd

	local atmo = getOrCreateEffect("Atmosphere", "SciFiAtmosphere") :: Atmosphere
	atmo.Density = LightingProfile.Atmosphere.Density
	atmo.Offset = LightingProfile.Atmosphere.Offset
	atmo.Color = LightingProfile.Atmosphere.Color
	atmo.Decay = LightingProfile.Atmosphere.Decay
	atmo.Glare = LightingProfile.Atmosphere.Glare
	atmo.Haze = LightingProfile.Atmosphere.Haze
	atmosphereInstance = atmo

	local bloom = getOrCreateEffect("BloomEffect", "SciFiBloom") :: BloomEffect
	bloom.Enabled = PostProcessing.Bloom.Enabled
	bloom.Intensity = PostProcessing.Bloom.Intensity
	bloom.Size = PostProcessing.Bloom.Size
	bloom.Threshold = PostProcessing.Bloom.Threshold
	bloomInstance = bloom

	local cc = getOrCreateEffect("ColorCorrectionEffect", "SciFiColorCorrection") :: ColorCorrectionEffect
	cc.Enabled = PostProcessing.ColorCorrection.Enabled
	cc.Brightness = PostProcessing.ColorCorrection.Brightness
	cc.Contrast = PostProcessing.ColorCorrection.Contrast
	cc.Saturation = PostProcessing.ColorCorrection.Saturation
	cc.TintColor = PostProcessing.ColorCorrection.TintColor
	colorCorrectionInstance = cc

	local dof = getOrCreateEffect("DepthOfFieldEffect", "SciFiDepthOfField") :: DepthOfFieldEffect
	dof.Enabled = PostProcessing.DepthOfField.Enabled
	dof.FarIntensity = PostProcessing.DepthOfField.FarIntensity
	dof.FocusDistance = PostProcessing.DepthOfField.FocusDistance
	dof.InFocusRadius = PostProcessing.DepthOfField.InFocusRadius
	dof.NearIntensity = PostProcessing.DepthOfField.NearIntensity
	depthOfFieldInstance = dof

	local sunRays = getOrCreateEffect("SunRaysEffect", "SciFiSunRays") :: SunRaysEffect
	sunRays.Enabled = PostProcessing.SunRays.Enabled
	sunRays.Intensity = PostProcessing.SunRays.Intensity
	sunRays.Spread = PostProcessing.SunRays.Spread
	sunRaysInstance = sunRays
end

local function isPlayerAimingDownSights(): boolean
	if WeaponController ~= nil then
		if WeaponController.IsADS == true or WeaponController.IsAiming == true then
			return true
		end
		if type(WeaponController.IsAimingDownSights) == "function" then
			local ok, aiming = pcall(WeaponController.IsAimingDownSights, WeaponController)
			if ok and aiming == true then
				return true
			end
		end
	end
	return false
end

local function resolveADSFov(): number
	local weaponDataAny = WeaponData :: any
	if WeaponController ~= nil and type(WeaponController.CurrentWeaponId) == "string" then
		local stats = WeaponData.GetWeapon(WeaponController.CurrentWeaponId) :: any
		if stats and type(stats.ADSFov) == "number" then
			return stats.ADSFov
		end
	end
	if type(weaponDataAny.ADSFov) == "number" then
		return weaponDataAny.ADSFov
	end
	return PostProcessing.ADSFov
end

local function getPlanarSpeed(): number
	local movementAny = MovementController :: any
	if type(movementAny.CurrentPlanarSpeed) == "number" then
		return movementAny.CurrentPlanarSpeed
	end
	if type(movementAny.GetPlanarSpeed) == "function" then
		local ok, speed = pcall(movementAny.GetPlanarSpeed, movementAny)
		if ok and type(speed) == "number" then
			return speed
		end
	end
	return 0
end

local function updateCameraFOV(dt: number): ()
	local camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
	if not camera then
		return
	end

	local targetFOV = BASE_FOV
	if isPlayerAimingDownSights() then
		targetFOV = resolveADSFov()
	else
		local planarSpeed = getPlanarSpeed()
		local speedRange = math.max(FOV_MAX_SPEED_REF - FOV_SPEED_THRESHOLD, 1)
		local speedAlpha = math.clamp((planarSpeed - FOV_SPEED_THRESHOLD) / speedRange, 0, 1)
		targetFOV = math.clamp(BASE_FOV + (MAX_SPEED_FOV_BOOST * speedAlpha), BASE_FOV, MAX_FOV)
	end

	local lerpAlpha = 1 - math.exp(-FOV_LERP_SPEED * math.min(dt, 0.1))
	camera.FieldOfView = camera.FieldOfView + (targetFOV - camera.FieldOfView) * lerpAlpha
end

function GraphicsController.SetCompetitiveMode(isLow: boolean): ()
	isCompetitiveLow = isLow == true
	local tier = if isCompetitiveLow then GraphicsQualityTiers.Low else GraphicsQualityTiers.High
	currentTier = tier

	Lighting.GlobalShadows = tier.GlobalShadows
	Lighting.ShadowSoftness = tier.ShadowSoftness
	Lighting.EnvironmentDiffuseScale = tier.EnvironmentDiffuseScale
	Lighting.EnvironmentSpecularScale = tier.EnvironmentSpecularScale

	if atmosphereInstance then
		atmosphereInstance.Density = tier.AtmosphereDensity
		atmosphereInstance.Glare = tier.AtmosphereGlare
		atmosphereInstance.Haze = tier.AtmosphereHaze
	end

	if bloomInstance then
		bloomInstance.Enabled = tier.BloomEnabled
	end

	if colorCorrectionInstance then
		colorCorrectionInstance.Enabled = tier.ColorCorrectionEnabled
	end

	if depthOfFieldInstance then
		depthOfFieldInstance.Enabled = tier.DepthOfFieldEnabled
	end

	if sunRaysInstance then
		sunRaysInstance.Enabled = tier.SunRaysEnabled
	end
end

function GraphicsController.IsCompetitiveMode(): boolean
	return isCompetitiveLow
end

function GraphicsController.GetCurrentTier(): GraphicsQualityTiers.QualityTierSpec
	return currentTier
end

function GraphicsController.Init(): ()
	if initialized then
		return
	end
	initialized = true

	applyBaseLightingProfile()
	GraphicsController.SetCompetitiveMode(false)

	local camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
	if camera then
		camera.FieldOfView = BASE_FOV
	end

	if fovConnection then
		fovConnection:Disconnect()
	end
	fovConnection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(updateCameraFOV)
end

return table.freeze(GraphicsController)
````

## File: src/client/graphics/VFXController.luau
````
--!strict
--[[
	VFXController.luau
	Zero-allocation particle VFX dispatcher for weapon muzzle flashes and surface impact sparks.
	Uses pre-allocated attachment ring-buffer pools parented to Workspace.Terrain so zero
	instances are created or garbage-collected per shot.
]]

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local PresetsFolder = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Graphics"):WaitForChild("Presets")
local GraphicsQualityTiers = require(PresetsFolder:WaitForChild("GraphicsQualityTiers"))
local GraphicsController = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("GraphicsController"))

type PooledImpactNode = {
	Attachment: Attachment,
	SparkEmitter: ParticleEmitter,
	CoreFlashEmitter: ParticleEmitter,
}

type PooledMuzzleNode = {
	Attachment: Attachment,
	FlashEmitter: ParticleEmitter,
	SparkEmitter: ParticleEmitter,
	FlashLight: PointLight,
}

local IMPACT_POOL_SIZE = 24
local MUZZLE_POOL_SIZE = 8

local initialized = false
local impactPool: { PooledImpactNode } = table.create(IMPACT_POOL_SIZE)
local impactPoolCursor = 0

local muzzlePool: { PooledMuzzleNode } = table.create(MUZZLE_POOL_SIZE)
local muzzlePoolCursor = 0
local boundMuzzleMap: { [Attachment]: PooledMuzzleNode } = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }) :: any

local VFXController = {}

local function createImpactNode(index: number): PooledImpactNode
	local attachment = Instance.new("Attachment")
	attachment.Name = string.format("PooledImpactVFX_%02d", index)
	attachment.Parent = Workspace.Terrain

	local sparkEmitter = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
	sparkEmitter.Name = "ImpactSparks"
	sparkEmitter.Enabled = false
	sparkEmitter.Color = ColorSequence.new({
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(170, 245, 255)),
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.45, Color3.fromRGB(0, 210, 255)),
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(255, 130, 40)),
	})
	sparkEmitter.LightEmission = 1
	sparkEmitter.LightInfluence = 0
	sparkEmitter.Brightness = 3
	sparkEmitter.Size = NumberSequence.new({
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.18),
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.7, 0.1),
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0),
	})
	sparkEmitter.Squash = NumberSequence.new({
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1.8),
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 2.5),
	})
	sparkEmitter.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0),
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.8, 0.25),
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
	})
	sparkEmitter.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.14, 0.28)
	sparkEmitter.Speed = NumberRange.new(18, 38)
	sparkEmitter.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(42, 42)
	sparkEmitter.Drag = 4.5
	sparkEmitter.Acceleration = Vector3.new(0, -65, 0)
	sparkEmitter.EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Front
	sparkEmitter.Parent = attachment

	local coreFlash = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
	coreFlash.Name = "ImpactCoreFlash"
	coreFlash.Enabled = false
	coreFlash.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(190, 248, 255), Color3.fromRGB(0, 195, 255))
	coreFlash.LightEmission = 1
	coreFlash.LightInfluence = 0
	coreFlash.Brightness = 4
	coreFlash.Size = NumberSequence.new({
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.65),
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0),
	})
	coreFlash.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.05),
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
	})
	coreFlash.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.05, 0.08)
	coreFlash.Speed = NumberRange.new(0, 0)
	coreFlash.Parent = attachment

	return {
		Attachment = attachment,
		SparkEmitter = sparkEmitter,
		CoreFlashEmitter = coreFlash,
	}
end

local function createMuzzleNode(index: number): PooledMuzzleNode
	local attachment = Instance.new("Attachment")
	attachment.Name = string.format("PooledMuzzleVFX_%02d", index)
	attachment.Parent = Workspace.Terrain

	local flashEmitter = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
	flashEmitter.Name = "MuzzleCoreFlash"
	flashEmitter.Enabled = false
	flashEmitter.LockedToPart = true
	flashEmitter.Color = ColorSequence.new({
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(235, 252, 255)),
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, Color3.fromRGB(0, 220, 255)),
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(0, 120, 255)),
	})
	flashEmitter.LightEmission = 1
	flashEmitter.LightInfluence = 0
	flashEmitter.Brightness = 4
	flashEmitter.Size = NumberSequence.new({
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.55),
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, 0.9),
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0),
	})
	flashEmitter.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0),
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
	})
	flashEmitter.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.035, 0.055)
	flashEmitter.Speed = NumberRange.new(0, 2)
	flashEmitter.RotSpeed = NumberRange.new(-360, 360)
	flashEmitter.Rotation = NumberRange.new(0, 360)
	flashEmitter.EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Front
	flashEmitter.Parent = attachment

	local sparkEmitter = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
	sparkEmitter.Name = "MuzzleSparks"
	sparkEmitter.Enabled = false
	sparkEmitter.LockedToPart = true
	sparkEmitter.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(165, 245, 255), Color3.fromRGB(0, 185, 255))
	sparkEmitter.LightEmission = 1
	sparkEmitter.LightInfluence = 0
	sparkEmitter.Brightness = 3
	sparkEmitter.Size = NumberSequence.new({
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.14),
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0),
	})
	sparkEmitter.Squash = NumberSequence.new(1.5, 2.2)
	sparkEmitter.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0),
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
	})
	sparkEmitter.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.04, 0.08)
	sparkEmitter.Speed = NumberRange.new(14, 28)
	sparkEmitter.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(22, 22)
	sparkEmitter.EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Front
	sparkEmitter.Parent = attachment

	local flashLight = Instance.new("PointLight")
	flashLight.Name = "MuzzleLight"
	flashLight.Enabled = false
	flashLight.Color = Color3.fromRGB(70, 225, 255)
	flashLight.Brightness = 2.4
	flashLight.Range = 9
	flashLight.Shadows = false
	flashLight.Parent = attachment

	return {
		Attachment = attachment,
		FlashEmitter = flashEmitter,
		SparkEmitter = sparkEmitter,
		FlashLight = flashLight,
	}
end

local function ensurePoolsAllocated(): ()
	if #impactPool == 0 then
		for i = 1, IMPACT_POOL_SIZE do
			impactPool[i] = createImpactNode(i)
		end
	end
	if #muzzlePool == 0 then
		for i = 1, MUZZLE_POOL_SIZE do
			muzzlePool[i] = createMuzzleNode(i)
		end
	end
end

function VFXController.Init(): ()
	if initialized then
		return
	end
	initialized = true
	ensurePoolsAllocated()
end

function VFXController.EmitMuzzleFlash(attachment: Attachment): ()
	if typeof(attachment) ~= "Instance" or not attachment:IsA("Attachment") then
		return
	end

	ensurePoolsAllocated()

	local node = boundMuzzleMap[attachment]
	if not node then
		muzzlePoolCursor = (muzzlePoolCursor % MUZZLE_POOL_SIZE) + 1
		node = muzzlePool[muzzlePoolCursor]
		boundMuzzleMap[attachment] = node
		node.FlashEmitter.Parent = attachment
		node.SparkEmitter.Parent = attachment
		node.FlashLight.Parent = attachment
	end

	local tier = if GraphicsController.IsCompetitiveMode()
		then GraphicsQualityTiers.Low
		else GraphicsQualityTiers.High

	node.FlashEmitter:Emit(2)
	node.SparkEmitter:Emit(tier.MuzzleSparkCount)
end

function VFXController.SpawnImpactSparks(position: Vector3, normal: Vector3): ()
	ensurePoolsAllocated()

	impactPoolCursor = (impactPoolCursor % IMPACT_POOL_SIZE) + 1
	local node = impactPool[impactPoolCursor]

	local safeNormal = if normal.Magnitude > 1e-4 then normal.Unit else Vector3.yAxis
	node.Attachment.WorldCFrame = CFrame.lookAt(position, position + safeNormal)

	local tier = if GraphicsController.IsCompetitiveMode()
		then GraphicsQualityTiers.Low
		else GraphicsQualityTiers.High

	node.CoreFlashEmitter:Emit(1)
	node.SparkEmitter:Emit(tier.ImpactSparkCount)
end

return table.freeze(VFXController)
````

## File: src/client/ui/CrosshairModule.luau
````
--!strict
--[[
	CrosshairModule.luau
	Minimalist 4-bracket + center dot velocity-reactive sci-fi reticle.
	Dynamically expands with MovementController.CurrentPlanarSpeed, tightens during
	ViewmodelController.IsADS(), and flashes Neon Cyan (body) or Neon Orange/Red (headshot).
]]

local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local clientRoot = script.Parent.Parent
local MovementController = require(clientRoot:WaitForChild("movement"):WaitForChild("MovementController")) :: any
local ViewmodelController = require(clientRoot:WaitForChild("viewmodel"):WaitForChild("ViewmodelController")) :: any

local CrosshairModule = {}

-- Visual & Telemetry Constants
local BASE_GAP_PX = 8
local ADS_GAP_MULTIPLIER = 0.42
local SPEED_TO_GAP_FACTOR = 0.35
local MAX_SPEED_GAP_ADDITION = 28
local GAP_LERP_SPEED = 18

local BRACKET_LENGTH = 8
local BRACKET_THICKNESS = 2
local HIT_FLASH_DURATION = 0.18

local COLOR_DEFAULT = Color3.fromRGB(225, 248, 255)
local COLOR_ADS = Color3.fromRGB(0, 240, 255)
local COLOR_HIT_BODY = Color3.fromRGB(0, 240, 255) -- #00F0FF Neon Cyan
local COLOR_HIT_HEAD = Color3.fromRGB(255, 78, 0) -- #FF4E00 Neon Orange/Red
local COLOR_STROKE = Color3.fromRGB(10, 14, 20)

-- Internal State
local isInitialized = false
local rootFrame: Frame? = nil
local centerDot: Frame? = nil
local topBracket: Frame? = nil
local bottomBracket: Frame? = nil
local leftBracket: Frame? = nil
local rightBracket: Frame? = nil
local hitTicks: { Frame } = {}

local currentGap = BASE_GAP_PX
local hitFlashRemaining = 0
local lastHitHeadshot = false
local renderConnection: RBXScriptConnection? = nil

local function createBracket(name: string, parent: GuiObject, size: UDim2): Frame
	local bracket = Instance.new("Frame")
	bracket.Name = name
	bracket.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	bracket.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
	bracket.Size = size
	bracket.BackgroundColor3 = COLOR_DEFAULT
	bracket.BorderSizePixel = 0
	bracket.Parent = parent

	local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	stroke.Color = COLOR_STROKE
	stroke.Thickness = 1
	stroke.Transparency = 0.35
	stroke.Parent = bracket

	return bracket
end

local function createHitTick(index: number, rotationDeg: number, parent: GuiObject): Frame
	local holder = Instance.new("Frame")
	holder.Name = string.format("HitTick_%d", index)
	holder.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	holder.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
	holder.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(2, 7)
	holder.Rotation = rotationDeg
	holder.BackgroundColor3 = COLOR_HIT_BODY
	holder.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	holder.BorderSizePixel = 0
	holder.Parent = parent

	return holder
end

local function readPlanarSpeed(): number
	if type(MovementController) == "table" then
		if type(MovementController.CurrentPlanarSpeed) == "number" then
			return MovementController.CurrentPlanarSpeed
		elseif type(MovementController.GetPlanarSpeed) == "function" then
			local ok, val = pcall(MovementController.GetPlanarSpeed)
			if ok and type(val) == "number" then
				return val
			end
		end
	end
	return 0
end

local function readIsADS(): boolean
	if type(ViewmodelController) == "table" then
		if type(ViewmodelController.IsADS) == "function" then
			local ok, result = pcall(ViewmodelController.IsADS)
			if ok and type(result) == "boolean" then
				return result
			end
		elseif type(ViewmodelController.IsADS) == "boolean" then
			return ViewmodelController.IsADS
		end
	end
	return false
end

local function updateReticle(dt: number)
	local root = rootFrame
	local dot = centerDot
	local topB = topBracket
	local bottomB = bottomBracket
	local leftB = leftBracket
	local rightB = rightBracket

	if not (root and dot and topB and bottomB and leftB and rightB) then
		return
	end

	local speed = readPlanarSpeed()
	local isAds = readIsADS()

	local speedSpread = math.clamp(speed * SPEED_TO_GAP_FACTOR, 0, MAX_SPEED_GAP_ADDITION)
	local targetGap = BASE_GAP_PX + speedSpread
	if isAds then
		targetGap = math.max(3, targetGap * ADS_GAP_MULTIPLIER)
	end

	local alpha = math.clamp(dt * GAP_LERP_SPEED, 0, 1)
	currentGap = currentGap + (targetGap - currentGap) * alpha

	local activeColor = if isAds then COLOR_ADS else COLOR_DEFAULT
	local hitExpand = 0

	if hitFlashRemaining > 0 then
		hitFlashRemaining = math.max(0, hitFlashRemaining - dt)
		local flashRatio = hitFlashRemaining / HIT_FLASH_DURATION
		local flashColor = if lastHitHeadshot then COLOR_HIT_HEAD else COLOR_HIT_BODY
		activeColor = activeColor:Lerp(flashColor, flashRatio)
		hitExpand = flashRatio * (if lastHitHeadshot then 5 else 3)

		local tickDist = 10 + flashRatio * 4
		for i, tick in ipairs(hitTicks) do
			local angleRad = math.rad((i - 1) * 90 + 45)
			local ox = math.cos(angleRad) * tickDist
			local oy = math.sin(angleRad) * tickDist
			tick.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, math.round(ox), 0.5, math.round(oy))
			tick.BackgroundColor3 = flashColor
			tick.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - flashRatio
		end
	else
		for _, tick in ipairs(hitTicks) do
			tick.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		end
	end

	local finalGap = math.round(currentGap + hitExpand)

	dot.BackgroundColor3 = activeColor
	topB.BackgroundColor3 = activeColor
	bottomB.BackgroundColor3 = activeColor
	leftB.BackgroundColor3 = activeColor
	rightB.BackgroundColor3 = activeColor

	topB.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, -(finalGap + BRACKET_LENGTH * 0.5))
	bottomB.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, finalGap + BRACKET_LENGTH * 0.5)
	leftB.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -(finalGap + BRACKET_LENGTH * 0.5), 0.5, 0)
	rightB.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, finalGap + BRACKET_LENGTH * 0.5, 0.5, 0)
end

function CrosshairModule.Init(parentGui: ScreenGui)
	if isInitialized then
		if rootFrame and parentGui then
			rootFrame.Parent = parentGui
		end
		return
	end
	isInitialized = true

	local container = Instance.new("Frame")
	container.Name = "CrosshairContainer"
	container.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	container.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
	container.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(120, 120)
	container.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	container.Parent = parentGui
	rootFrame = container

	-- Center Dot (2x2 px)
	local dot = Instance.new("Frame")
	dot.Name = "CenterDot"
	dot.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	dot.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
	dot.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(2, 2)
	dot.BackgroundColor3 = COLOR_DEFAULT
	dot.BorderSizePixel = 0
	dot.Parent = container

	local dotStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	dotStroke.Color = COLOR_STROKE
	dotStroke.Thickness = 1
	dotStroke.Transparency = 0.35
	dotStroke.Parent = dot
	centerDot = dot

	-- 4 Minimalist Sci-Fi Brackets
	topBracket = createBracket("TopBracket", container, UDim2.fromOffset(BRACKET_THICKNESS, BRACKET_LENGTH))
	bottomBracket = createBracket("BottomBracket", container, UDim2.fromOffset(BRACKET_THICKNESS, BRACKET_LENGTH))
	leftBracket = createBracket("LeftBracket", container, UDim2.fromOffset(BRACKET_LENGTH, BRACKET_THICKNESS))
	rightBracket = createBracket("RightBracket", container, UDim2.fromOffset(BRACKET_LENGTH, BRACKET_THICKNESS))

	-- 4 Diagonal Hitmarker Ticks
	table.clear(hitTicks)
	for i = 1, 4 do
		local rot = (i - 1) * 90 + 45
		table.insert(hitTicks, createHitTick(i, rot, container))
	end

	if renderConnection then
		renderConnection:Disconnect()
	end
	renderConnection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(updateReticle)
end

function CrosshairModule.TriggerHitmarker(isHeadshot: boolean)
	lastHitHeadshot = isHeadshot == true
	hitFlashRemaining = HIT_FLASH_DURATION
	currentGap = currentGap + (if lastHitHeadshot then 4 else 2)
end

return CrosshairModule
````

## File: src/client/ui/HudApp.luau
````
--!strict
--[[
	HudApp.luau
	Minimalist glassmorphic sci-fi in-game HUD:
	- Bottom-center Speedometer (00.0 STUDS/S in Enum.Font.Code, shifts #00F0FF -> #FF6E00 above 45 studs/s)
	- Bottom-right Minimalist Ammo & Weapon Card reading live state from WeaponController
	- Bottom-left Health Bar tracking LocalPlayer.Character.Humanoid.Health
	- Top-right KILLS / DEATHS / PEAK SPEED mini-telemetry badge
]]

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local clientRoot = script.Parent.Parent

local MovementController = require(clientRoot:WaitForChild("movement"):WaitForChild("MovementController")) :: any
local WeaponController = require(clientRoot:WaitForChild("combat"):WaitForChild("WeaponController")) :: any
local CrosshairModule = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("CrosshairModule"))
local LobbyApp = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("LobbyApp"))

-- Shared WeaponData lookup
local WeaponData: { [string]: any } = {}
do
	local sharedFolder = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Shared") or ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Shared", 5)
	if sharedFolder then
		local configs = sharedFolder:FindFirstChild("configs")
		local weaponDataModule = if configs then configs:FindFirstChild("WeaponData") else nil
		if weaponDataModule and weaponDataModule:IsA("ModuleScript") then
			local ok, data = pcall(require, weaponDataModule)
			if ok and type(data) == "table" then
				WeaponData = data
			end
		end
	end
end

local HudApp = {}

-- Glassmorphic Visual Constants
local CARD_BG_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(10, 14, 20)
local CARD_BG_TRANSPARENCY = 0.35
local COLOR_NEON_CYAN = Color3.fromRGB(0, 240, 255) -- #00F0FF
local COLOR_OVERDRIVE_ORANGE = Color3.fromRGB(255, 110, 0) -- #FF6E00
local COLOR_CRITICAL_RED = Color3.fromRGB(255, 55, 65)
local COLOR_TEXT_PRIMARY = Color3.fromRGB(235, 248, 255)
local COLOR_TEXT_MUTED = Color3.fromRGB(130, 155, 175)

local OVERDRIVE_SPEED_THRESHOLD = 45.0
local MAX_SPEED_BAR_REFERENCE = 80.0

local DEFAULT_WEAPON_META: { [string]: { DisplayName: string, MagazineSize: number } } = {
	VORTEX_SMG = { DisplayName = "VORTEX SMG", MagazineSize = 30 },
	HELIOS_RAIL = { DisplayName = "HELIOS RAIL", MagazineSize = 5 },
}

-- Internal UI References
local isInitialized = false
local hudGui: ScreenGui? = nil

-- Speedometer Refs
local speedTextLabel: TextLabel? = nil
local speedStateLabel: TextLabel? = nil
local speedFillBar: Frame? = nil
local speedStroke: UIStroke? = nil

-- Health Refs
local healthValueLabel: TextLabel? = nil
local healthFillBar: Frame? = nil
local healthStroke: UIStroke? = nil

-- Ammo & Weapon Refs
local weaponNameLabel: TextLabel? = nil
local ammoCurrentLabel: TextLabel? = nil
local ammoMaxLabel: TextLabel? = nil
local ammoFillBar: Frame? = nil
local ammoStroke: UIStroke? = nil

-- Top-Right Telemetry Badge Refs
local killsValueLabel: TextLabel? = nil
local deathsValueLabel: TextLabel? = nil
local peakSpeedValueLabel: TextLabel? = nil
local telemetryStroke: UIStroke? = nil

local humanoidConnections: { RBXScriptConnection } = {}

local function createGlassCard(
	name: string,
	parent: Instance,
	size: UDim2,
	position: UDim2,
	anchorPoint: Vector2
): (Frame, UIStroke)
	local card = Instance.new("Frame")
	card.Name = name
	card.Size = size
	card.Position = position
	card.AnchorPoint = anchorPoint
	card.BackgroundColor3 = CARD_BG_COLOR
	card.BackgroundTransparency = CARD_BG_TRANSPARENCY
	card.BorderSizePixel = 0
	card.Parent = parent

	local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
	corner.Parent = card

	local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	stroke.Color = COLOR_NEON_CYAN
	stroke.Thickness = 1
	stroke.Transparency = 0.25
	stroke.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
	stroke.Parent = card

	return card, stroke
end

local function readPlanarSpeed(): number
	if type(MovementController) == "table" then
		if type(MovementController.CurrentPlanarSpeed) == "number" then
			return MovementController.CurrentPlanarSpeed
		elseif type(MovementController.GetPlanarSpeed) == "function" then
			local ok, speed = pcall(MovementController.GetPlanarSpeed)
			if ok and type(speed) == "number" then
				return speed
			end
		end
	end
	return 0
end

local function readWeaponTelemetry(): (string, number, number, boolean)
	local weaponId = "VORTEX_SMG"
	local currentAmmo: number? = nil
	local maxAmmo: number? = nil
	local isReloading = false

	if type(WeaponController) == "table" then
		local rawId = WeaponController.CurrentWeaponId
			or WeaponController.EquippedWeaponId
			or WeaponController.CurrentWeapon
			or WeaponController.WeaponId
		if type(rawId) == "string" and #rawId > 0 then
			weaponId = rawId
		elseif type(WeaponController.GetEquippedWeapon) == "function" then
			local ok, res = pcall(WeaponController.GetEquippedWeapon)
			if ok and type(res) == "string" and #res > 0 then
				weaponId = res
			end
		end

		if type(WeaponController.CurrentAmmo) == "number" then
			currentAmmo = WeaponController.CurrentAmmo
		elseif type(WeaponController.Ammo) == "number" then
			currentAmmo = WeaponController.Ammo
		elseif type(WeaponController.GetAmmo) == "function" then
			local ok, cur, max = pcall(WeaponController.GetAmmo)
			if ok and type(cur) == "number" then
				currentAmmo = cur
				if type(max) == "number" then
					maxAmmo = max
				end
			end
		end

		if type(WeaponController.MaxAmmo) == "number" then
			maxAmmo = WeaponController.MaxAmmo
		elseif type(WeaponController.MagazineSize) == "number" then
			maxAmmo = WeaponController.MagazineSize
		end

		if type(WeaponController.IsReloading) == "boolean" then
			isReloading = WeaponController.IsReloading
		elseif type(WeaponController.IsReloading) == "function" then
			local ok, rel = pcall(WeaponController.IsReloading)
			if ok and type(rel) == "boolean" then
				isReloading = rel
			end
		end
	end

	local attrWeapon = LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("EquippedWeapon") or LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("SelectedWeapon")
	if type(attrWeapon) == "string" and #attrWeapon > 0 and weaponId == "VORTEX_SMG" then
		weaponId = attrWeapon
	end

	local configEntry = WeaponData[weaponId] or (WeaponData.Weapons and WeaponData.Weapons[weaponId])
	local fallbackMeta = DEFAULT_WEAPON_META[weaponId] or { DisplayName = weaponId, MagazineSize = 30 }

	local resolvedMax = maxAmmo
		or (
			if type(configEntry) == "table"
				then (configEntry.MagazineSize or configEntry.MaxAmmo or configEntry.AmmoCapacity)
				else nil
		)
		or fallbackMeta.MagazineSize

	local resolvedCurrent = currentAmmo or resolvedMax
	local displayName = (
		if type(configEntry) == "table" and type(configEntry.DisplayName or configEntry.Name) == "string"
			then (configEntry.DisplayName or configEntry.Name)
			else fallbackMeta.DisplayName
	)

	return string.upper(displayName),
		math.max(0, math.floor(resolvedCurrent)),
		math.max(1, math.floor(resolvedMax)),
		isReloading
end

local function updateHealthDisplay(health: number, maxHealth: number)
	local safeMax = if maxHealth > 0 then maxHealth else 100
	local clampedHealth = math.clamp(health, 0, safeMax)
	local ratio = clampedHealth / safeMax
	local isLow = ratio <= 0.35
	local accentColor = if isLow then COLOR_CRITICAL_RED else COLOR_NEON_CYAN

	if healthValueLabel then
		healthValueLabel.Text = string.format("%03d", math.ceil(clampedHealth))
		healthValueLabel.TextColor3 = if isLow then COLOR_CRITICAL_RED else COLOR_TEXT_PRIMARY
	end
	if healthFillBar then
		healthFillBar.Size = UDim2.fromScale(ratio, 1)
		healthFillBar.BackgroundColor3 = accentColor
	end
	if healthStroke then
		healthStroke.Color = accentColor
	end
end

local function updateTopRightTelemetryBadge()
	local rawKills = LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("Kills")
	local rawDeaths = LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("Deaths")
	local rawTopSpeed = LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("TopBhopSpeed")

	local kills = if type(rawKills) == "number" then math.max(0, math.floor(rawKills)) else 0
	local deaths = if type(rawDeaths) == "number" then math.max(0, math.floor(rawDeaths)) else 0
	local topSpeed = if type(rawTopSpeed) == "number" then math.max(0, rawTopSpeed) else 0.0

	local planarSpeed = readPlanarSpeed()
	if planarSpeed > topSpeed then
		topSpeed = planarSpeed
	end

	local isOverdrivePeak = topSpeed > OVERDRIVE_SPEED_THRESHOLD

	if killsValueLabel then
		killsValueLabel.Text = string.format("%02d", kills)
	end
	if deathsValueLabel then
		deathsValueLabel.Text = string.format("%02d", deaths)
	end
	if peakSpeedValueLabel then
		peakSpeedValueLabel.Text = string.format("%04.1f", topSpeed)
		peakSpeedValueLabel.TextColor3 = if isOverdrivePeak then COLOR_OVERDRIVE_ORANGE else COLOR_NEON_CYAN
	end
	if telemetryStroke then
		telemetryStroke.Color = if isOverdrivePeak then COLOR_OVERDRIVE_ORANGE else COLOR_NEON_CYAN
	end
end

local function bindCharacter(character: Model?)
	for _, conn in ipairs(humanoidConnections) do
		conn:Disconnect()
	end
	table.clear(humanoidConnections)

	if not character then
		updateHealthDisplay(100, 100)
		return
	end

	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") or character:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 5) :: Humanoid?
	if humanoid and humanoid:IsA("Humanoid") then
		updateHealthDisplay(humanoid.Health, humanoid.MaxHealth)
		table.insert(
			humanoidConnections,
			humanoid.HealthChanged:Connect(function(newHealth: number)
				updateHealthDisplay(newHealth, humanoid.MaxHealth)
			end)
		)
	end
end

local function updateHudTelemetry()
	-- 1. Speedometer Update
	local speed = readPlanarSpeed()
	local isOverdrive = speed > OVERDRIVE_SPEED_THRESHOLD
	local speedAccent = if isOverdrive then COLOR_OVERDRIVE_ORANGE else COLOR_NEON_CYAN

	if speedTextLabel then
		speedTextLabel.Text = string.format("%04.1f STUDS/S", speed)
		speedTextLabel.TextColor3 = speedAccent
	end
	if speedStateLabel then
		speedStateLabel.Text = if isOverdrive then "OVERDRIVE // BHOP VELOCITY" else "TELEMETRY // PLANAR VELOCITY"
		speedStateLabel.TextColor3 = if isOverdrive then COLOR_OVERDRIVE_ORANGE else COLOR_TEXT_MUTED
	end
	if speedFillBar then
		local fillRatio = math.clamp(speed / MAX_SPEED_BAR_REFERENCE, 0, 1)
		speedFillBar.Size = UDim2.fromScale(fillRatio, 1)
		speedFillBar.BackgroundColor3 = speedAccent
	end
	if speedStroke then
		speedStroke.Color = speedAccent
	end

	-- 2. Ammo & Weapon Update
	local weaponName, curAmmo, maxAmmo, isReloading = readWeaponTelemetry()
	local ammoRatio = math.clamp(curAmmo / math.max(1, maxAmmo), 0, 1)
	local isLowAmmo = (ammoRatio <= 0.25) or isReloading
	local ammoAccent = if isReloading
		then COLOR_OVERDRIVE_ORANGE
		elseif isLowAmmo then COLOR_CRITICAL_RED
		else COLOR_NEON_CYAN

	if weaponNameLabel then
		weaponNameLabel.Text = if isReloading then weaponName .. " // RELOADING" else weaponName
		weaponNameLabel.TextColor3 = if isReloading then COLOR_OVERDRIVE_ORANGE else COLOR_NEON_CYAN
	end
	if ammoCurrentLabel then
		ammoCurrentLabel.Text = string.format("%02d", curAmmo)
		ammoCurrentLabel.TextColor3 = if isLowAmmo then ammoAccent else COLOR_TEXT_PRIMARY
	end
	if ammoMaxLabel then
		ammoMaxLabel.Text = string.format("/ %02d", maxAmmo)
	end
	if ammoFillBar then
		ammoFillBar.Size = UDim2.fromScale(ammoRatio, 1)
		ammoFillBar.BackgroundColor3 = ammoAccent
	end
	if ammoStroke then
		ammoStroke.Color = ammoAccent
	end

	-- 3. Top-Right Kills / Deaths / Peak Speed Telemetry
	updateTopRightTelemetryBadge()

	-- 4. Live Character Health Sync
	local character = LocalPlayer.Character
	if character then
		local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if humanoid then
			updateHealthDisplay(humanoid.Health, humanoid.MaxHealth)
		end
	end
end

function HudApp.SetVisible(visible: boolean)
	if hudGui then
		hudGui.Enabled = visible
	end
end

function HudApp.Init()
	if isInitialized then
		return
	end
	isInitialized = true

	screenGui.DisplayOrder = 5
	screenGui.Parent = playerGui
	hudGui = screenGui

	-- Initialize Crosshair inside HUD ScreenGui
	CrosshairModule.Init(screenGui)

	-- Register CrosshairModule.TriggerHitmarker into WeaponController.OnHitConfirmed
	if type(WeaponController) == "table" then
		local existingHook = WeaponController.OnHitConfirmed
		if existingHook == nil then
			WeaponController.OnHitConfirmed = CrosshairModule.TriggerHitmarker
		elseif typeof(existingHook) == "Instance" and existingHook:IsA("BindableEvent") then
			existingHook.Event:Connect(CrosshairModule.TriggerHitmarker)
		elseif type(existingHook) == "table" and type(existingHook.Connect) == "function" then
			existingHook:Connect(CrosshairModule.TriggerHitmarker)
		end
	end

	-- =========================================================================

	-- =========================================================================

	-- =========================================================================
	local healthCard, hStroke = createGlassCard(
		"HealthCard",

	)
	healthStroke = hStroke

	hVal.Font = Enum.Font.Code
	hVal.Text = "100"
	hVal.TextSize = 24
	hVal.TextColor3 = COLOR_TEXT_PRIMARY
	hVal.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	hVal.Parent = healthCard
	healthValueLabel = hVal

	local hUnit = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	hUnit.Name = "UnitLabel"
	hUnit.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	hUnit.Position = UDim2.new(1, -64, 0, 28)
	hUnit.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(50, 18)

	hBarBg.BorderSizePixel = 0

	local hBarFill = Instance.new("Frame")
	hBarFill.Name = "Fill"
	hBarFill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)

	hBarFill.BorderSizePixel = 0

	-- =========================================================================

	-- =========================================================================
	local ammoCard, aStroke = createGlassCard(
		"AmmoWeaponCard",
		screenGui,
		UDim2.fromOffset(230, 68),
		UDim2.new(1, -32, 1, -28),
		Vector2.new(1, 1)
	)
	ammoStroke = aStroke

	local wLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	wLabel.Name = "WeaponName"
	wLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1

	local aBarBg = Instance.new("Frame")
	aBarBg.Name = "AmmoBarBg"
	aBarBg.Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 1, -12)
	aBarBg.Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, 5)
	aBarBg.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25, 34, 48)
	aBarBg.BorderSizePixel = 0
	aBarBg.Parent = ammoCard

	local aBarFill = Instance.new("Frame")
	aBarFill.Name = "Fill"
	aBarFill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)

	RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(updateHudTelemetry)

	-- Sync visibility with Arena attribute & ensure LobbyApp is initialized
	local function syncArenaVisibility()
		local inArena = LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("InArena") == true
		HudApp.SetVisible(inArena)
	end
	LocalPlayer:GetAttributeChangedSignal("InArena"):Connect(syncArenaVisibility)
	syncArenaVisibility()

	LobbyApp.Init()
end

return HudApp

## File: src/client/init.client.luau
````
--!strict

local function requireClientModule(moduleName: string, directPath: Instance?): any
	if directPath and directPath:IsA("ModuleScript") then
		return require(directPath)
	end

	local found = script:FindFirstChild(moduleName, true)
	if found and found:IsA("ModuleScript") then
		return require(found)
	end

	error(`[ClientBootstrap] Missing required client module: {moduleName}`)
end

local TracerPool = requireClientModule("TracerPool", script.combat:FindFirstChild("TracerPool"))
local SlideController = requireClientModule("SlideController", script.movement:FindFirstChild("SlideController"))
local MovementController = requireClientModule(
	"MovementController",
	script.movement:FindFirstChild("MovementController")
)
local ViewmodelController = requireClientModule(
	"ViewmodelController",
	script.viewmodel:FindFirstChild("ViewmodelController")
)
local WeaponController = requireClientModule("WeaponController", script.combat:FindFirstChild("WeaponController"))
local GraphicsController = requireClientModule(
	"GraphicsController",
	script.graphics:FindFirstChild("GraphicsController")
)
local VFXController = requireClientModule("VFXController", script.graphics:FindFirstChild("VFXController"))
local AudioController = requireClientModule("AudioController", script.audio:FindFirstChild("AudioController"))
local HudApp = requireClientModule("HudApp", script.ui:FindFirstChild("HudApp"))
local LobbyApp = requireClientModule("LobbyApp", script.ui:FindFirstChild("LobbyApp"))

TracerPool.Init()
SlideController.Init()
MovementController.Init()
ViewmodelController.Init()
WeaponController.Init()
GraphicsController.Init()
VFXController.Init()
AudioController.Init()
HudApp.Init()
LobbyApp.Init()
````

## File: src/server/combat/CombatValidator.luau
````
--!strict
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local HitboxHistory = require(script.Parent.HitboxHistory)
local ShotPacket = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Shared"):WaitForChild("network"):WaitForChild("ShotPacket"))
local WeaponData = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Shared"):WaitForChild("configs"):WaitForChild("WeaponData"))

local successLoadout, LoadoutService = pcall(function()
	return require(script.Parent.LoadoutService)
end)

local CombatValidator = {}

local fireEvent: RemoteEvent
local hitConfirmEvent: RemoteEvent
local reloadEvent: RemoteEvent

type WeaponState = {
	ammo: number,
	lastShotTime: number,
	reloadEndTime: number,
}

type PlayerCombatState = {
	weapons: { [string]: WeaponState },
}

local playerStates: { [Player]: PlayerCombatState } = {}

function CombatValidator.Init()
	fireEvent = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("FireWeaponBuffer") :: RemoteEvent
	if not fireEvent then
		fireEvent = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
		fireEvent.Name = "FireWeaponBuffer"
		fireEvent.Parent = ReplicatedStorage
	end

	hitConfirmEvent = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("HitConfirmEvent") :: RemoteEvent
	if not hitConfirmEvent then
		hitConfirmEvent = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
		hitConfirmEvent.Name = "HitConfirmEvent"
		hitConfirmEvent.Parent = ReplicatedStorage
	end

	reloadEvent = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("ReloadWeaponEvent") :: RemoteEvent
	if not reloadEvent then
		reloadEvent = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
		reloadEvent.Name = "ReloadWeaponEvent"
		reloadEvent.Parent = ReplicatedStorage
	end

	local function initPlayerWeapons(player: Player)
		local weaponsState = {}
		for weaponName, data in pairs(WeaponData) do
			if type(data) == "table" and (data.MagazineSize or data.magazineSize) then
				weaponsState[weaponName] = {
					ammo = data.MagazineSize or data.magazineSize or 30,
					lastShotTime = 0,
					reloadEndTime = 0,
				}
			end
		end
		playerStates[player] = {
			weapons = weaponsState,
		}
	end

	Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
		initPlayerWeapons(player)
		player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
			local pState = playerStates[player]
			if pState then
				for weaponName, wState in pairs(pState.weapons) do
					local wConfig = WeaponData[weaponName]
					if wConfig and type(wConfig) == "table" then
						wState.ammo = wConfig.MagazineSize or wConfig.magazineSize or 30
					else
						wState.ammo = 30
					end
					wState.reloadEndTime = 0
				end
			else
				initPlayerWeapons(player)
			end
		end)
	end)

	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
		playerStates[player] = nil
	end)

	reloadEvent.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(shooter: Player)
		local pState = playerStates[shooter]
		if not pState then
			return
		end

		local weaponName = "VORTEX_SMG"
		if successLoadout and LoadoutService and type(LoadoutService.getCurrentWeapon) == "function" then
			local current = LoadoutService.getCurrentWeapon(shooter)
			if current then
				weaponName = current
			end
		end
		if not weaponName or weaponName == "" then
			weaponName = shooter:GetAttribute("SelectedWeapon") or "VORTEX_SMG"
		end

		local weaponConfig = nil
		if type(WeaponData.GetWeapon) == "function" then
			weaponConfig = WeaponData.GetWeapon(weaponName)
		end
		if not weaponConfig then
			weaponConfig = WeaponData[weaponName]
		end
		if not weaponConfig then
			return
		end

		local wState = pState.weapons[weaponName]
		if not wState then
			wState = { ammo = weaponConfig.MagazineSize or 30, lastShotTime = 0, reloadEndTime = 0 }
			pState.weapons[weaponName] = wState
		end

		wState.reloadEndTime = Workspace:GetServerTimeNow() + (weaponConfig.ReloadTime or 1.5)
		wState.ammo = weaponConfig.MagazineSize or weaponConfig.magazineSize or 30
	end)

	fireEvent.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(shooter: Player, payload: any)
		if not payload or typeof(payload) ~= "buffer" then
			return
		end

		local success, isValid, timestamp, origin, direction = pcall(function()
			return ShotPacket.Decode(payload)
		end)

		if not success or not isValid or not timestamp or not origin or not direction then
			return
		end

		local char = shooter.Character
		if not char then
			return
		end
		local head = char:FindFirstChild("Head")
		if not head or not head:IsA("BasePart") then
			return
		end

		if (origin - head.Position).Magnitude > 14 then
			return
		end

		local weaponName = "VORTEX_SMG"
		if successLoadout and LoadoutService and type(LoadoutService.getCurrentWeapon) == "function" then
			local current = LoadoutService.getCurrentWeapon(shooter)
			if current then
				weaponName = current
			end
		end
		if not weaponName or weaponName == "" then
			weaponName = shooter:GetAttribute("SelectedWeapon") or "VORTEX_SMG"
		end

		local weaponConfig = nil
		if type(WeaponData.GetWeapon) == "function" then
			weaponConfig = WeaponData.GetWeapon(weaponName)
		end
		if not weaponConfig then
			weaponConfig = WeaponData[weaponName]
		end
		if not weaponConfig then
			return
		end

		local pState = playerStates[shooter]
		if not pState then
			return
		end
		local wState = pState.weapons[weaponName]
		if not wState then
			wState = { ammo = weaponConfig.MagazineSize or 30, lastShotTime = 0, reloadEndTime = 0 }
			pState.weapons[weaponName] = wState
		end

		local now = Workspace:GetServerTimeNow()

		if now < wState.reloadEndTime then
			return
		end

		local rpm = weaponConfig.FireRateRPM or weaponConfig.RPM or 600
		local minInterval = 60 / rpm
		if (now - wState.lastShotTime) < (minInterval * 0.8) then
			return
		end

		if wState.ammo <= 0 then
			return
		end

		wState.ammo -= 1
		wState.lastShotTime = now

		local restoreFn = HitboxHistory.RewindToTimestamp(shooter, timestamp)

		local range = weaponConfig.MaxRange or weaponConfig.Range or 1000

		local raycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
		raycastParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
		raycastParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = { char }
		raycastParams.IgnoreWater = true

		local rayResult = Workspace:Raycast(origin, direction.Unit * range, raycastParams)

		restoreFn()

		if rayResult and rayResult.Instance then
			local hitPart = rayResult.Instance
			local hitModel = hitPart:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
			if hitModel then
				local humanoid = hitModel:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
				if humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
					local baseDamage = weaponConfig.BaseDamage or weaponConfig.Damage or 22
					local damage = baseDamage
					if hitPart.Name == "Head" then
						damage *= (weaponConfig.HeadshotMultiplier or 2.0)
					end

					local healthBefore = humanoid.Health
					humanoid:TakeDamage(damage)
					if healthBefore > 0 and humanoid.Health <= 0 then
						local currentKills = (shooter:GetAttribute("Kills") :: number?) or 0
						shooter:SetAttribute("Kills", currentKills + 1)
					end

					hitConfirmEvent:FireClient(shooter, {
						hitPosition = rayResult.Position,
						hitPart = hitPart,
						isHeadshot = (hitPart.Name == "Head"),
						damage = damage,
					})
				end
			end
		end
	end)
end

return CombatValidator
````

## File: src/server/combat/HitboxHistory.luau
````
--!strict
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local HitboxHistory = {}

type PartState = {
	cf: CFrame,
	anchored: boolean,
	canQuery: boolean,
}

type Snapshot = {
	time: number,
	parts: { [BasePart]: PartState },
}

local playerHistories: { [Player]: { Snapshot } } = {}
local MAX_HISTORY_DURATION = 1.0 -- 1 second
local MAX_REWIND = 0.45 -- 450ms max rewind

function HitboxHistory.Init()
	RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
		local now = Workspace:GetServerTimeNow()

		for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
			local character = player.Character
			if character and character.Parent then
				local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
				if humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
					if not playerHistories[player] then
						playerHistories[player] = {}
					end

					local partsMap: { [BasePart]: PartState } = {}
					for _, desc in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
						if desc:IsA("BasePart") then
							partsMap[desc] = {
								cf = desc.CFrame,
								anchored = desc.Anchored,
								canQuery = desc.CanQuery,
							}
						end
					end

					local history = playerHistories[player]
					table.insert(history, {
						time = now,
						parts = partsMap,
					})

					-- Prune snapshots older than 1.0 second
					while #history > 0 and (now - history[1].time) > MAX_HISTORY_DURATION do
						table.remove(history, 1)
					end
				else
					playerHistories[player] = nil
				end
			else
				playerHistories[player] = nil
			end
		end
	end)

	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
		playerHistories[player] = nil
	end)
end

function HitboxHistory.RewindToTimestamp(shooter: Player, targetTimestamp: number): () -> ()
	local now = Workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
	local minAllowedTime = now - MAX_REWIND
	targetTimestamp = math.clamp(targetTimestamp, minAllowedTime, now)

	local originalStates: { [BasePart]: PartState } = {}

	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		if player ~= shooter then
			local character = player.Character
			if character and character.Parent then
				local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
				if humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
					local history = playerHistories[player]
					if history and #history > 0 then
						local s1, s2
						for i = 1, #history - 1 do
							if history[i].time <= targetTimestamp and history[i + 1].time >= targetTimestamp then
								s1 = history[i]
								s2 = history[i + 1]
								break
							end
						end

						local targetPartsState: { [BasePart]: PartState }? = nil
						if s1 and s2 then
							local alpha = 0
							if s2.time > s1.time then
								alpha = (targetTimestamp - s1.time) / (s2.time - s1.time)
							end
							targetPartsState = {}
							for part, data1 in pairs(s1.parts) do
								local data2 = s2.parts[part]
								if data2 and part.Parent then
									originalStates[part] = {
										cf = part.CFrame,
										anchored = part.Anchored,
										canQuery = part.CanQuery,
									}
									targetPartsState[part] = {
										cf = data1.cf:Lerp(data2.cf, alpha),
										anchored = true,
										canQuery = true,
									}
								end
							end
						else
							-- Fallback to nearest snapshot
							local nearest = history[1]
							local minDiff = math.abs(nearest.time - targetTimestamp)
							for i = 2, #history do
								local diff = math.abs(history[i].time - targetTimestamp)
								if diff < minDiff then
									minDiff = diff
									nearest = history[i]
								end
							end
							if nearest then
								targetPartsState = {}
								for part, data in pairs(nearest.parts) do
									if part.Parent then
										targetPartsState[part] = {
											cf = data.cf,
											anchored = true,
											canQuery = true,
										}
									end
								end
							end
						end

						if targetPartsState then
							for part, state in pairs(targetPartsState) do
								if part.Parent then
									if not originalStates[part] then
										originalStates[part] = {
											cf = part.CFrame,
											anchored = part.Anchored,
											canQuery = part.CanQuery,
										}
									end
									part.CFrame = state.cf
									part.Anchored = state.anchored
									part.CanQuery = state.canQuery
								end
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end

	local restored = false
	local function restoreFn()
		if restored then
			return
		end
		restored = true
		for part, state in pairs(originalStates) do
			if part.Parent then
				part.CFrame = state.cf
				part.Anchored = state.anchored
				part.CanQuery = state.canQuery
			end
		end
	end

	return restoreFn
end

return HitboxHistory
````

## File: src/server/replication/StanceReplicator.luau
````
--!strict
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local StanceReplicator = {}

local stanceSyncEvent: UnreliableRemoteEvent
local lastSyncTimes: { [Player]: number } = {}
local RATE_LIMIT_INTERVAL = 1 / 30 -- 30Hz rate limit

function StanceReplicator.Init()
	stanceSyncEvent = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("StanceSyncBuffer") :: UnreliableRemoteEvent
	if not stanceSyncEvent then
		stanceSyncEvent = Instance.new("UnreliableRemoteEvent")
		stanceSyncEvent.Name = "StanceSyncBuffer"
		stanceSyncEvent.Parent = ReplicatedStorage
	end

	stanceSyncEvent.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(sender: Player, packetBuffer: buffer)
		if typeof(packetBuffer) ~= "buffer" then
			return
		end

		if buffer.len(packetBuffer) < 5 then
			return
		end

		local now = Workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
		local lastTime = lastSyncTimes[sender] or 0
		if (now - lastTime) < RATE_LIMIT_INTERVAL then
			return
		end

		local success, pitch, isSliding = pcall(function()
			local p = buffer.readf32(packetBuffer, 0)
			local s = buffer.readu8(packetBuffer, 4)
			return p, s
		end)

		if not success or pitch == nil or isSliding == nil then
			return
		end

		-- Validate pitch is finite and within bounds
		if pitch ~= pitch or math.abs(pitch) == math.huge then
			return
		end
		if math.abs(pitch) > math.pi * 0.55 then
			return
		end

		lastSyncTimes[sender] = now

		-- Broadcast stance buffer to all other clients
		for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
			if player ~= sender then
				stanceSyncEvent:FireClient(player, sender, packetBuffer)
			end
		end
	end)

	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
		lastSyncTimes[player] = nil
	end)
end

return StanceReplicator
````

local function requireServerModule(moduleName: string, directPath: Instance?): any
	if directPath and directPath:IsA("ModuleScript") then
		return require(directPath)
	end

	local found = script:FindFirstChild(moduleName, true)
	if found and found:IsA("ModuleScript") then
		return require(found)
	end

	error(`[ServerBootstrap] Missing required server module: {moduleName}`)
end

	"HitboxHistory",

)

	"MatchService",

)

## File: src/shared/math/QuakeMath.luau
````
--!strict
--[[
	QuakeMath.luau
	Pure vector math library implementing Quake III / Source Engine air-strafe
	dot-product velocity projection, ground friction decay, and planar speed clamping.
]]

local STOP_SPEED_DEFAULT = 10

local QuakeMath = {}

--[[
	Projects currentVel onto wishDir and adds acceleration up to wishSpeed.
	Because projection uses the dot product (currentVel:Dot(wishDir)), strafing
	nearly perpendicular to currentVel yields a small currentSpeed projection,
	allowing total planar speed to exceed wishSpeed during air-strafing.
]]
function QuakeMath.Accelerate(
	currentVel: Vector3,
	wishDir: Vector3,
	wishSpeed: number,
	accel: number,
	dt: number
): Vector3
	local planarWish = Vector3.new(wishDir.X, 0, wishDir.Z)
	if planarWish.Magnitude <= 1e-6 or wishSpeed <= 0 or dt <= 0 then
		return currentVel
	end
	local unitWish = planarWish.Unit

	local currentSpeed = currentVel:Dot(unitWish)
	local addSpeed = wishSpeed - currentSpeed
	if addSpeed <= 0 then
		return currentVel
	end

	local accelSpeed = accel * dt * wishSpeed
	if accelSpeed > addSpeed then
		accelSpeed = addSpeed
	end

	return currentVel + (unitWish * accelSpeed)
end

--[[
	Applies Quake/Source ground friction to the horizontal (XZ) components of currentVel
	while preserving vertical (Y) velocity.
]]
function QuakeMath.ApplyFriction(
	currentVel: Vector3,
	friction: number,
	dt: number,
	stopSpeed: number?
): Vector3
	local planarVel = Vector3.new(currentVel.X, 0, currentVel.Z)
	local speed = planarVel.Magnitude
	if speed <= 1e-5 or dt <= 0 or friction <= 0 then
		return Vector3.new(0, currentVel.Y, 0)
	end

	local effectiveStopSpeed = stopSpeed or STOP_SPEED_DEFAULT
	local control = if speed < effectiveStopSpeed then effectiveStopSpeed else speed
	local drop = control * friction * dt

	local newSpeed = speed - drop
	if newSpeed < 0 then
		newSpeed = 0
	end

	local scale = newSpeed / speed
	return Vector3.new(currentVel.X * scale, currentVel.Y, currentVel.Z * scale)
end

--[[
	Hard-clamps horizontal (XZ) speed to maxSpeed while preserving vertical (Y) velocity.
]]
function QuakeMath.ClampPlanarSpeed(vel: Vector3, maxSpeed: number): Vector3
	if maxSpeed <= 0 then
		return Vector3.new(0, vel.Y, 0)
	end

	local planarVel = Vector3.new(vel.X, 0, vel.Z)
	local planarSpeed = planarVel.Magnitude
	if planarSpeed <= maxSpeed or planarSpeed <= 1e-6 then
		return vel
	end

	local clampedPlanar = planarVel.Unit * maxSpeed
	return Vector3.new(clampedPlanar.X, vel.Y, clampedPlanar.Z)
end

return table.freeze(QuakeMath)
````

## File: src/shared/math/Spring.luau
````
--!strict
--[[
	Spring.luau
	3D Hooke's Law damped harmonic oscillator with 8 fixed substeps per update.
	Used for procedural viewmodel sway, recoil kick, landing bob, and camera tilt.
]]

local ITERATIONS = 8

local Spring = {}
Spring.__index = Spring

export type Spring = typeof(setmetatable(
	{} :: {
		Target: Vector3,
		Position: Vector3,
		Velocity: Vector3,
		Mass: number,
		Force: number,
		Damping: number,
		Speed: number,
	},
	Spring
))

function Spring.new(mass: number?, force: number?, damping: number?, speed: number?): Spring
	local self = setmetatable({
		Target = Vector3.zero,
		Position = Vector3.zero,
		Velocity = Vector3.zero,
		Mass = mass or 5,
		Force = force or 50,
		Damping = damping or 4,
		Speed = speed or 4,
	}, Spring)

	return self
end

function Spring.Shove(self: Spring, impulse: Vector3): ()
	local x = impulse.X
	local y = impulse.Y
	local z = impulse.Z

	if x ~= x or x == math.huge or x == -math.huge then
		x = 0
	end
	if y ~= y or y == math.huge or y == -math.huge then
		y = 0
	end
	if z ~= z or z == math.huge or z == -math.huge then
		z = 0
	end

	self.Velocity += Vector3.new(x, y, z)
end

function Spring.Update(self: Spring, dt: number): Vector3
	local scaledDeltaTime = math.min(dt, 0.1) * self.Speed / ITERATIONS
	local mass = math.max(self.Mass, 1e-4)
	local force = self.Force
	local damping = self.Damping
	local target = self.Target
	local position = self.Position
	local velocity = self.Velocity

	for _ = 1, ITERATIONS do
		local displacement = target - position
		local acceleration = (displacement * force) / mass - velocity * damping

		velocity += acceleration * scaledDeltaTime
		position += velocity * scaledDeltaTime
	end

	self.Position = position
	self.Velocity = velocity

	return position
end

function Spring.Reset(self: Spring): ()
	self.Target = Vector3.zero
	self.Position = Vector3.zero
	self.Velocity = Vector3.zero
end

return table.freeze(Spring)
````
