## File: src/client/movement/MovementController.luau
````
--!strict

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local MovementConfig = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.configs.MovementConfig)
local QuakeMath = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.math.QuakeMath)
local SlideController = require(script.Parent.SlideController)

local GROUND_RAY_LENGTH: number = MovementConfig.GroundRayLength or 3.4
local OVERHEAD_CLEARANCE_RAY_LENGTH: number = 3.6
local JUMP_VELOCITY: number = MovementConfig.JumpVelocity or 42
local JUMP_GRACE_DURATION: number = 0.05
local GRAVITY: number = MovementConfig.Gravity or Workspace.Gravity
local GROUND_ACCELERATE: number = MovementConfig.GroundAccelerate or MovementConfig.Accelerate or 14
local AIR_ACCELERATE: number = MovementConfig.AirAccelerate or 120
local MAX_GROUND_SPEED: number = MovementConfig.MaxGroundSpeed or MovementConfig.WalkSpeed or 24
local MAX_AIR_WISH_SPEED: number = MovementConfig.MaxAirWishSpeed or 6.5
local GROUND_FRICTION: number = MovementConfig.GroundFriction or MovementConfig.Friction or 6
local SLIDE_FRICTION: number = MovementConfig.SlideFriction or 1.25
local STOP_SPEED: number = MovementConfig.StopSpeed or 10
local HARD_SPEED_CAP: number = MovementConfig.HardSpeedCap or 85

local STANCE_SYNC_INTERVAL: number = 0.05
local STANCE_STANDING: number = 0
local STANCE_AIRBORNE: number = 1
local STANCE_SLIDING: number = 2

local localPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

local MovementController = {
	CurrentPlanarSpeed = 0,
	IsGrounded = false,
	IsSliding = false,
	Velocity = Vector3.zero,
	OnLandedCallbacks = {} :: { (impactVelocityY: number) -> () },
}

local jumpQueued = false
local slideQueued = false
local wasGrounded = false
local jumpGraceTimer = 0
local planarVelocity = Vector3.zero
local verticalVelocity = 0
local initialized = false

local stanceBuf = buffer.create(5)
local stanceSyncAccumulator = 0
local stanceRemote: UnreliableRemoteEvent? = nil

local cachedCharacter: Model? = nil
local defaultRootJointC0: CFrame? = nil
local defaultLeftHipC0: CFrame? = nil
local defaultRightHipC0: CFrame? = nil
local defaultRootCanCollide: boolean? = nil
local defaultLeftLegCanCollide: boolean? = nil
local defaultRightLegCanCollide: boolean? = nil

local raycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
raycastParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
raycastParams.IgnoreWater = true

local function cacheCharacterRig(character: Model, rootPart: BasePart)
	if cachedCharacter == character then
		return
	end
	cachedCharacter = character

	local torso = (character:FindFirstChild("Torso") or character:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")) :: BasePart?
	local rootJoint = (
		rootPart:FindFirstChild("RootJoint") or (torso and torso:FindFirstChild("RootJoint"))
	) :: Motor6D?
	local leftHip = (torso and torso:FindFirstChild("Left Hip")) :: Motor6D?
	local rightHip = (torso and torso:FindFirstChild("Right Hip")) :: Motor6D?
	local leftLeg = character:FindFirstChild("Left Leg") :: BasePart?
	local rightLeg = character:FindFirstChild("Right Leg") :: BasePart?

	defaultRootJointC0 = if rootJoint then rootJoint.C0 else nil
	defaultLeftHipC0 = if leftHip then leftHip.C0 else nil
	defaultRightHipC0 = if rightHip then rightHip.C0 else nil
	defaultRootCanCollide = rootPart.CanCollide
	defaultLeftLegCanCollide = if leftLeg then leftLeg.CanCollide else nil
	defaultRightLegCanCollide = if rightLeg then rightLeg.CanCollide else nil
end

local function updateSlideColliderAndRig(
	character: Model,
	rootPart: BasePart,
	isCrouched: boolean,
	cameraOffsetY: number
)
	cacheCharacterRig(character, rootPart)

	local head = character:FindFirstChild("Head") :: BasePart?
	local torso = (character:FindFirstChild("Torso") or character:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")) :: BasePart?
	local leftLeg = character:FindFirstChild("Left Leg") :: BasePart?
	local rightLeg = character:FindFirstChild("Right Leg") :: BasePart?
	local rootJoint = (
		rootPart:FindFirstChild("RootJoint") or (torso and torso:FindFirstChild("RootJoint"))
	) :: Motor6D?
	local leftHip = (torso and torso:FindFirstChild("Left Hip")) :: Motor6D?
	local rightHip = (torso and torso:FindFirstChild("Right Hip")) :: Motor6D?

	if isCrouched then
		if head then
			head.CanCollide = false
		end
		if torso then
			torso.CanCollide = false
		end
		if leftLeg and rightLeg then
			rootPart.CanCollide = false
			leftLeg.CanCollide = true
			rightLeg.CanCollide = true
		end
	else
		if head then
			head.CanCollide = true
		end
		if torso then
			torso.CanCollide = true
		end
		if defaultRootCanCollide ~= nil then
			rootPart.CanCollide = defaultRootCanCollide
		end
		if leftLeg and defaultLeftLegCanCollide ~= nil then
			leftLeg.CanCollide = defaultLeftLegCanCollide
		end
		if rightLeg and defaultRightLegCanCollide ~= nil then
			rightLeg.CanCollide = defaultRightLegCanCollide
		end
	end

	if rootJoint and defaultRootJointC0 then
		rootJoint.C0 = CFrame.new(0, cameraOffsetY, 0) * defaultRootJointC0
	end
	if leftHip and defaultLeftHipC0 then
		leftHip.C0 = CFrame.new(0, -cameraOffsetY, 0) * defaultLeftHipC0
	end
	if rightHip and defaultRightHipC0 then
		rightHip.C0 = CFrame.new(0, -cameraOffsetY, 0) * defaultRightHipC0
	end
end

local function getWishDirection(): Vector3
	local camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
	if not camera then
		return Vector3.zero
	end

	local forward = Vector3.new(camera.CFrame.LookVector.X, 0, camera.CFrame.LookVector.Z)
	local right = Vector3.new(camera.CFrame.RightVector.X, 0, camera.CFrame.RightVector.Z)

	if forward.Magnitude > 1e-4 then
		forward = forward.Unit
	end
	if right.Magnitude > 1e-4 then
		right = right.Unit
	end

	local moveInput = Vector3.zero
	if UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox() == nil then
		if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) then
			moveInput += forward
		end
		if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) then
			moveInput -= forward
		end
		if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) then
			moveInput += right
		end
		if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) then
			moveInput -= right
		end
	end

	if moveInput.Magnitude > 1e-4 then
		return moveInput.Unit
	end

	return Vector3.zero
end

local function isSlideKey(keyCode: Enum.KeyCode): boolean
	return keyCode == Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl or keyCode == Enum.KeyCode.C
end

function MovementController.Init()
	if initialized then
		return
	end
	initialized = true

	SlideController.Init()

	local existingRemote = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("StanceSyncBuffer")
	if existingRemote and existingRemote:IsA("UnreliableRemoteEvent") then
		stanceRemote = existingRemote
	else
		task.spawn(function()
			local waited = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("StanceSyncBuffer")
			if waited and waited:IsA("UnreliableRemoteEvent") then
				stanceRemote = waited
			end
		end)
	end

	UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input: InputObject, gameProcessed: boolean)
		if gameProcessed then
			return
		end

		if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Space then
			jumpQueued = true
		elseif isSlideKey(input.KeyCode) then
			slideQueued = true
			if MovementController.IsGrounded and not SlideController.IsSliding then
				planarVelocity = SlideController.TryStartSlide(planarVelocity, true)
			end
		end
	end)

	UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input: InputObject)
		if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Space then
			jumpQueued = false
		elseif isSlideKey(input.KeyCode) then
			slideQueued = false
			SlideController.StopSlide()
		end
	end)

	localPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
		planarVelocity = Vector3.zero
		verticalVelocity = 0
		wasGrounded = false
		jumpGraceTimer = 0
		cachedCharacter = nil
		MovementController.CurrentPlanarSpeed = 0
		MovementController.IsGrounded = false
		MovementController.IsSliding = false
		MovementController.Velocity = Vector3.zero
		SlideController.Init()
	end)

	RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt: number)
		local character = localPlayer.Character
		if not character then
			return
		end

		local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		local rootPart = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart?
		if not humanoid or not rootPart or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
			return
		end

		humanoid.EvaluateStateMachine = false

		if UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox() == nil then
			jumpQueued = UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space)
		end

		if jumpGraceTimer > 0 then
			jumpGraceTimer = math.max(0, jumpGraceTimer - dt)
		end

		raycastParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = { character }
		local groundHit = Workspace:Raycast(
			rootPart.Position,
			Vector3.new(0, -GROUND_RAY_LENGTH, 0),
			raycastParams
		)

		local isGrounded = false
		if jumpGraceTimer <= 0 then
			isGrounded = groundHit ~= nil and groundHit.Normal.Y >= 0.5 and verticalVelocity <= 0.01
		end

		local landedThisFrame = isGrounded and not wasGrounded

		if landedThisFrame then
			local impactVelocityY = math.abs(verticalVelocity)
			for _, callback in MovementController.OnLandedCallbacks do
				task.spawn(callback, impactVelocityY)
			end

			if slideQueued and not SlideController.IsSliding then
				planarVelocity = SlideController.TryStartSlide(planarVelocity, true)
			end
		end

		-- Auto-Bhop: on landing frame (or while grounded), if jumpQueued is true,
		-- immediately apply JumpVelocity, start the 0.05s grace window, and mark airborne
		-- so QuakeMath.ApplyFriction is bypassed.
		if isGrounded and jumpQueued then
			verticalVelocity = JUMP_VELOCITY
			jumpGraceTimer = JUMP_GRACE_DURATION
			isGrounded = false
		elseif isGrounded then
			verticalVelocity = 0
		end

		local wishDir = getWishDirection()

		if isGrounded then
			local activeFriction = if SlideController.IsSliding then SLIDE_FRICTION else GROUND_FRICTION
			planarVelocity = QuakeMath.ApplyFriction(planarVelocity, activeFriction, dt, STOP_SPEED)

			if not SlideController.IsSliding then
				planarVelocity = QuakeMath.Accelerate(
					planarVelocity,
					wishDir,
					MAX_GROUND_SPEED,
					GROUND_ACCELERATE,
					dt
				)
			end
		else
			planarVelocity = QuakeMath.Accelerate(
				planarVelocity,
				wishDir,
				MAX_AIR_WISH_SPEED,
				AIR_ACCELERATE,
				dt
			)
			verticalVelocity -= GRAVITY * dt
		end

		local currentSpeed = planarVelocity.Magnitude
		if currentSpeed > HARD_SPEED_CAP then
			planarVelocity = planarVelocity.Unit * HARD_SPEED_CAP
			currentSpeed = HARD_SPEED_CAP
		end

		-- Check 3.6-stud upward clearance before allowing the character to uncrouch
		local overheadHit = Workspace:Raycast(
			rootPart.Position,
			Vector3.new(0, OVERHEAD_CLEARANCE_RAY_LENGTH, 0),
			raycastParams
		)
		local hasOverheadClearance = overheadHit == nil

		SlideController.Step(dt, isGrounded, currentSpeed, hasOverheadClearance)
		humanoid.CameraOffset = Vector3.new(0, SlideController.CurrentCameraOffsetY, 0)
		updateSlideColliderAndRig(
			character,
			rootPart,
			SlideController.IsCrouched,
			SlideController.CurrentCameraOffsetY
		)

		local finalVelocity = Vector3.new(planarVelocity.X, verticalVelocity, planarVelocity.Z)
		rootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity = finalVelocity

		wasGrounded = isGrounded
		MovementController.CurrentPlanarSpeed = currentSpeed
		MovementController.IsGrounded = isGrounded
		MovementController.IsSliding = SlideController.IsSliding
		MovementController.Velocity = finalVelocity

		-- Replicate stance & camera look pitch at 20Hz (0.05s accumulator) using pre-allocated 5-byte buffer
		stanceSyncAccumulator += dt
		if stanceSyncAccumulator >= STANCE_SYNC_INTERVAL then
			stanceSyncAccumulator %= STANCE_SYNC_INTERVAL
			if stanceRemote then
				local camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
				local pitch = if camera
					then math.asin(math.clamp(camera.CFrame.LookVector.Y, -1, 1))
					else 0
				local stanceCode = if SlideController.IsSliding or SlideController.IsCrouched
					then STANCE_SLIDING
					elseif not isGrounded then STANCE_AIRBORNE
					else STANCE_STANDING

				buffer.writef32(stanceBuf, 0, pitch)
				buffer.writeu8(stanceBuf, 4, stanceCode)
				stanceRemote:FireServer(stanceBuf)
			end
		end
	end)
end

return MovementController
````

## File: src/client/movement/SlideController.luau
````
--!strict

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local MovementConfig = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.configs.MovementConfig)

local MIN_SLIDE_SPEED: number = MovementConfig.MinSlideSpeed or 22
local SLIDE_BOOST_IMPULSE: number = MovementConfig.SlideBoostImpulse or 14
local SLIDE_CAMERA_OFFSET_Y: number = MovementConfig.SlideCameraOffsetY or -2.2
local CAMERA_LERP_SPEED: number = MovementConfig.SlideCameraLerpSpeed or 14
local HARD_SPEED_CAP: number = MovementConfig.HardSpeedCap or 85

local SlideController = {
	IsSliding = false,
	IsCrouched = false,
	CurrentCameraOffsetY = 0,
}

function SlideController.Init()
	SlideController.IsSliding = false
	SlideController.IsCrouched = false
	SlideController.CurrentCameraOffsetY = 0
end

function SlideController.TryStartSlide(planarVelocity: Vector3, isGrounded: boolean): Vector3
	local flatVelocity = Vector3.new(planarVelocity.X, 0, planarVelocity.Z)
	local speed = flatVelocity.Magnitude

	if not isGrounded or speed < MIN_SLIDE_SPEED then
		return flatVelocity
	end

	SlideController.IsSliding = true
	SlideController.IsCrouched = true

	local boostDir = if speed > 1e-4 then flatVelocity.Unit else Vector3.zero
	local boostedVelocity = flatVelocity + (boostDir * SLIDE_BOOST_IMPULSE)

	if boostedVelocity.Magnitude > HARD_SPEED_CAP then
		boostedVelocity = boostedVelocity.Unit * HARD_SPEED_CAP
	end

	return boostedVelocity
end

function SlideController.StopSlide()
	SlideController.IsSliding = false
end

function SlideController.Step(
	dt: number,
	isGrounded: boolean,
	planarSpeed: number,
	hasOverheadClearance: boolean?
)
	local canUncrouch = if hasOverheadClearance == nil then true else hasOverheadClearance

	if SlideController.IsSliding then
		if planarSpeed < (MIN_SLIDE_SPEED * 0.6) then
			SlideController.IsSliding = false
		end
	end

	if SlideController.IsSliding then
		SlideController.IsCrouched = true
	elseif canUncrouch then
		SlideController.IsCrouched = false
	end

	local targetOffsetY = if (SlideController.IsSliding and isGrounded) or SlideController.IsCrouched
		then SLIDE_CAMERA_OFFSET_Y
		else 0

	local alpha = math.clamp(1 - math.exp(-CAMERA_LERP_SPEED * dt), 0, 1)
	SlideController.CurrentCameraOffsetY += (targetOffsetY - SlideController.CurrentCameraOffsetY) * alpha
end

return SlideController
````

--!strict

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

export type TrackName = "Idle" | "Equip" | "Reload" | "Fire"

type AnimEntry = {
	Id: string,
	Priority: Enum.AnimationPriority,
	FadeTime: number,
	Speed: number,
}

type WeaponAnimSet = {
	Idle: AnimEntry,
	Equip: AnimEntry,
	Reload: AnimEntry,
	Fire: AnimEntry,
	[string]: AnimEntry,
}

local FALLBACK_VIEWMODEL_ANIMS: { [string]: WeaponAnimSet } = table.freeze({
	VORTEX_SMG = table.freeze({
		Idle = table.freeze({
			Id = "rbxassetid://0",
			Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Idle,
			FadeTime = 0.15,
			Speed = 1.0,
		}),
		Equip = table.freeze({
			Id = "rbxassetid://0",
			Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action,
			FadeTime = 0.08,
			Speed = 1.25,
		}),
		Reload = table.freeze({
			Id = "rbxassetid://0",
			Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action2,
			FadeTime = 0.12,
			Speed = 1.0,
		}),
		Fire = table.freeze({
			Id = "rbxassetid://0",
			Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action3,
			FadeTime = 0.03,
			Speed = 1.35,
		}),
	}),
	HELIOS_RAIL = table.freeze({
		Idle = table.freeze({
			Id = "rbxassetid://0",
			Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Idle,
			FadeTime = 0.18,
			Speed = 0.9,
		}),
		Equip = table.freeze({
			Id = "rbxassetid://0",
			Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action,
			FadeTime = 0.12,
			Speed = 0.95,
		}),
		Reload = table.freeze({
			Id = "rbxassetid://0",
			Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action2,
			FadeTime = 0.15,
			Speed = 0.85,
		}),
		Fire = table.freeze({
			Id = "rbxassetid://0",
			Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action3,
			FadeTime = 0.04,
			Speed = 1.0,
		}),
	}),
})

local function resolveViewmodelAnims(): { [string]: WeaponAnimSet }
	local animationsFolder = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Animations", 5)
	if animationsFolder then
		local registryModuleOrFolder = animationsFolder:WaitForChild("Registry", 5)
		if registryModuleOrFolder then
			local vmModule = registryModuleOrFolder:WaitForChild("ViewmodelAnims", 5)
			if vmModule and vmModule:IsA("ModuleScript") then
				local ok, result = pcall(require, vmModule)
				if ok and type(result) == "table" then
					return result :: { [string]: WeaponAnimSet }
				end
			elseif registryModuleOrFolder:IsA("ModuleScript") then
				local ok, result = pcall(require, registryModuleOrFolder)
				if ok and type(result) == "table" and type(result.ViewmodelAnims) == "table" then
					return result.ViewmodelAnims :: { [string]: WeaponAnimSet }
				end
			end
		end
	end

	return FALLBACK_VIEWMODEL_ANIMS
end

local ViewmodelAnims = resolveViewmodelAnims()

local AnimatorBridge = {}

local currentAnimator: Animator? = nil
local currentWeaponId: string? = nil
local loadedTracks: { [string]: AnimationTrack } = {}
local trackConfigs: { [string]: AnimEntry } = {}
local animInstances: { Animation } = {}

local function getOrCreateAnimator(viewmodel: Model): Animator
	local existingAnimator = viewmodel:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Animator", true)
	if existingAnimator then
		return existingAnimator
	end

	local controller = viewmodel:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("AnimationController")
	if not controller then
		local newController = Instance.new("AnimationController")
		newController.Name = "AnimationController"
		newController.Parent = viewmodel
		controller = newController
	end

	local animator = Instance.new("Animator")
	animator.Name = "Animator"
	animator.Parent = controller
	return animator
end

local function isUsableAssetId(assetId: string): boolean
	return assetId ~= "" and assetId ~= "rbxassetid://0" and assetId ~= "0"
end

function AnimatorBridge.HasTrack(trackName: TrackName): boolean
	return loadedTracks[trackName] ~= nil
end

function AnimatorBridge.StopAll()
	for _, track in loadedTracks do
		if track.IsPlaying then
			pcall(function()
				track:Stop(0.1)
			end)
		end
		pcall(function()
			track:Destroy()
		end)
	end
	table.clear(loadedTracks)
	table.clear(trackConfigs)

	for _, anim in animInstances do
		anim:Destroy()
	end
	table.clear(animInstances)
end

function AnimatorBridge.BindRig(viewmodel: Model, weaponId: string)
	AnimatorBridge.StopAll()

	currentWeaponId = weaponId
	local animator = getOrCreateAnimator(viewmodel)
	currentAnimator = animator

	local animSet = ViewmodelAnims[weaponId] or ViewmodelAnims.VORTEX_SMG
	if not animSet then
		return
	end

	local trackNames: { TrackName } = { "Idle", "Equip", "Reload", "Fire" }
	for _, name in trackNames do
		local entry = animSet[name]
		if entry then
			trackConfigs[name] = entry
			if isUsableAssetId(entry.Id) then
				local anim = Instance.new("Animation")
				anim.Name = `{weaponId}_{name}`
				anim.AnimationId = entry.Id
				table.insert(animInstances, anim)

				local ok, trackOrErr = pcall(function()
					return animator:LoadAnimation(anim)
				end)
				if ok and trackOrErr then
					trackOrErr.Priority = entry.Priority
					trackOrErr.Looped = (name == "Idle")
					loadedTracks[name] = trackOrErr
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

function AnimatorBridge.PlayTrack(trackName: TrackName): boolean
	local config = trackConfigs[trackName]
	local track = loadedTracks[trackName]
	if not track or not config then
		return false
	end

	if trackName ~= "Idle" then
		for name, otherTrack in loadedTracks do
			if name ~= "Idle" and name ~= trackName and otherTrack.IsPlaying then
				pcall(function()
					otherTrack:Stop(config.FadeTime)
				end)
			end
		end
	end

	local ok = pcall(function()
		track.Priority = config.Priority
		track:Play(config.FadeTime, 1.0, config.Speed)
	end)

	return ok
end

return table.freeze(AnimatorBridge)
````

## File: src/client/viewmodel/ViewmodelController.luau
````
--!strict

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local AnimatorBridge = require(script.Parent.AnimatorBridge)

local Shared = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Shared")
local Configs = Shared:WaitForChild("configs")
local MathFolder = Shared:WaitForChild("math")

local AssetRegistry = require(Configs:WaitForChild("AssetRegistry")) :: any
local WeaponData = require(Configs:WaitForChild("WeaponData")) :: any
local SpringModule = require(MathFolder:WaitForChild("Spring")) :: any

local ClientRoot = script.Parent.Parent
local MovementFolder = ClientRoot:WaitForChild("movement")
local MovementController = require(MovementFolder:WaitForChild("MovementController")) :: any
local SlideController = require(MovementFolder:WaitForChild("SlideController")) :: any

type SpringAdapter = {
	Position: Vector3,
	Velocity: Vector3,
	Target: Vector3,
	Impulse: (self: SpringAdapter, impulse: Vector3) -> (),
	Update: (self: SpringAdapter, dt: number) -> Vector3,
}

local function createSpring(stiffness: number, damping: number, mass: number?): SpringAdapter
	local rawSpring: any = nil
	if type(SpringModule) == "table" and type(SpringModule.new) == "function" then
		local ok, instance = pcall(function()
			return SpringModule.new(mass or 1, stiffness, damping, 1)
		end)
		if ok and type(instance) == "table" then
			rawSpring = instance
		end
	end

	local adapter: SpringAdapter = {
		Position = Vector3.zero,
		Velocity = Vector3.zero,
		Target = Vector3.zero,

		Impulse = function(self: SpringAdapter, impulse: Vector3)
			self.Velocity += impulse
			if rawSpring then
				if type(rawSpring.Impulse) == "function" then
					pcall(rawSpring.Impulse, rawSpring, impulse)
				elseif type(rawSpring.Shove) == "function" then
					pcall(rawSpring.Shove, rawSpring, impulse)
				elseif type(rawSpring.shove) == "function" then
					pcall(rawSpring.shove, rawSpring, impulse)
				end
			end
		end,

		Update = function(self: SpringAdapter, dt: number): Vector3
			local clampedDt = math.min(dt, 1 / 15)
			if rawSpring then
				if rawSpring.Target ~= nil then
					rawSpring.Target = self.Target
				elseif rawSpring.target ~= nil then
					rawSpring.target = self.Target
				end

				local updateFn = rawSpring.Update or rawSpring.update or rawSpring.Step or rawSpring.step
				if type(updateFn) == "function" then
					local ok, res = pcall(updateFn, rawSpring, clampedDt)
					if ok and typeof(res) == "Vector3" then
						self.Position = res
						return res
					end
					local pos = rawSpring.Position or rawSpring.position
					if typeof(pos) == "Vector3" then
						self.Position = pos
						return pos
					end
				end
			end

			local displacement = self.Position - self.Target
			local accel = (-stiffness * displacement) - (damping * self.Velocity)
			self.Velocity += accel * clampedDt
			self.Position += self.Velocity * clampedDt
			return self.Position
		end,
	}

	return adapter
end

local RENDER_STEP_NAME = "SciFiViewmodelRender"
local HIP_OFFSET = CFrame.new(0.48, -0.42, -0.78)
local ADS_EYE_RELIEF = CFrame.new(0, 0, -0.55)
local STRAFE_ROLL_DEG = 4.5
local SLIDE_ROLL_DEG = -8.0
local RELOAD_DIP_Y = -0.22
local RELOAD_TILT_Z_RAD = math.rad(28)

local ViewmodelController = {}

local isInitialized = false
local isADSState = false
local adsAlpha = 0
local currentRollRad = 0
local bobPhase = 0

local isProceduralReloading = false
local reloadElapsed = 0
local reloadDuration = 0
local currentReloadAlpha = 0

local currentWeaponId: string = "VORTEX_SMG"
local activeViewmodel: Model? = nil
local rootPart: BasePart? = nil
local aimPart: BasePart? = nil
local weaponMesh: BasePart? = nil
local muzzleAttachment: Attachment? = nil

local swaySpring = createSpring(140, 16, 1)
local recoilPosSpring = createSpring(180, 18, 1)
local recoilRotSpring = createSpring(200, 16, 1)
local landingSpring = createSpring(150, 14, 1)

local inputConnections: { RBXScriptConnection } = {}

local function getWeaponConfig(weaponId: string): any
	if type(WeaponData) == "table" then
		if type(WeaponData[weaponId]) == "table" then
			return WeaponData[weaponId]
		end
		if type(WeaponData.Weapons) == "table" and type(WeaponData.Weapons[weaponId]) == "table" then
			return WeaponData.Weapons[weaponId]
		end
		if type(WeaponData.GetWeapon) == "function" then
			local ok, config = pcall(WeaponData.GetWeapon, weaponId)
			if ok and type(config) == "table" then
				return config
			end
		end
	end
	return nil
end

local function isSlidingActive(): boolean
	if type(SlideController) == "table" then
		if type(SlideController.IsSliding) == "function" then
			local ok, result = pcall(SlideController.IsSliding)
			if ok and type(result) == "boolean" then
				return result
			end
		elseif type(SlideController.IsSliding) == "boolean" then
			return SlideController.IsSliding
		end
	end

	if type(MovementController) == "table" then
		if type(MovementController.IsSliding) == "function" then
			local ok, result = pcall(MovementController.IsSliding)
			if ok and type(result) == "boolean" then
				return result
			end
		elseif type(MovementController.IsSliding) == "boolean" then
			return MovementController.IsSliding
		end
	end

	return false
end

local function getHorizontalSpeed(): number
	local localPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
	local character = if localPlayer then localPlayer.Character else nil
	local charRoot = if character then character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") else nil
	if charRoot and charRoot:IsA("BasePart") then
		local vel = charRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity
		return Vector3.new(vel.X, 0, vel.Z).Magnitude
	end
	return 0
end

local function tryLoadModelFromRegistry(weaponId: string): Model?
	if type(AssetRegistry) ~= "table" then
		return nil
	end

	if type(AssetRegistry.GetViewmodel) == "function" then
		local ok, model = pcall(AssetRegistry.GetViewmodel, weaponId)
		if ok and typeof(model) == "Instance" and model:IsA("Model") then
			return model:Clone()
		end
	end

	local viewmodelsTable = AssetRegistry.Viewmodels
		or (if type(AssetRegistry.Models) == "table" then AssetRegistry.Models.Viewmodels else nil)
	if type(viewmodelsTable) == "table" then
		local entry = viewmodelsTable[weaponId]
		if typeof(entry) == "Instance" and entry:IsA("Model") then
			return entry:Clone()
		end
	end

	return nil
end

local function constructProceduralViewmodel(weaponId: string): Model
	local isRailgun = (weaponId == "HELIOS_RAIL")

	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = `Viewmodel_{weaponId}`

	local root = Instance.new("Part")
	root.Name = "RootPart"
	root.Size = Vector3.new(0.2, 0.2, 0.2)
	root.Transparency = 1
	root.Anchored = true
	root.CanCollide = false
	root.CanQuery = false
	root.CanTouch = false
	root.Massless = true
	root.Parent = model
	model.PrimaryPart = root

	local meshPart = Instance.new("Part")
	meshPart.Name = "WeaponMesh"
	meshPart.Size = if isRailgun then Vector3.new(0.22, 0.28, 1.95) else Vector3.new(0.24, 0.26, 1.25)
	meshPart.Color = if isRailgun then Color3.fromRGB(255, 150, 45) else Color3.fromRGB(45, 220, 255)
	meshPart.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
	meshPart.Reflectance = 0.15
	meshPart.Anchored = false
	meshPart.CanCollide = false
	meshPart.CanQuery = false
	meshPart.CanTouch = false
	meshPart.Massless = true
	meshPart.CFrame = root.CFrame
	meshPart.Parent = model

	local rootToMesh = Instance.new("Motor6D")
	rootToMesh.Name = "WeaponMotor"
	rootToMesh.Part0 = root
	rootToMesh.Part1 = meshPart
	rootToMesh.C0 = CFrame.identity
	rootToMesh.C1 = CFrame.identity
	rootToMesh.Parent = root

	local aim = Instance.new("Part")
	aim.Name = "AimPart"
	aim.Size = Vector3.new(0.1, 0.1, 0.1)
	aim.Transparency = 1
	aim.Anchored = false
	aim.CanCollide = false
	aim.CanQuery = false
	aim.CanTouch = false
	aim.Massless = true
	local sightHeight = if isRailgun then 0.22 else 0.19
	aim.CFrame = root.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, sightHeight, 0.15)
	aim.Parent = model

	local rootToAim = Instance.new("Motor6D")
	rootToAim.Name = "AimMotor"
	rootToAim.Part0 = root
	rootToAim.Part1 = aim
	rootToAim.C0 = CFrame.new(0, sightHeight, 0.15)
	rootToAim.C1 = CFrame.identity
	rootToAim.Parent = root

	local muzzle = Instance.new("Attachment")
	muzzle.Name = "MuzzleAttachment"
	muzzle.Position = Vector3.new(0, 0.04, -meshPart.Size.Z * 0.5)
	muzzle.Parent = meshPart

	return model
end

local function bindViewmodelParts(model: Model)
	local foundRoot = model:FindFirstChild("RootPart") or model.PrimaryPart
	if not foundRoot or not foundRoot:IsA("BasePart") then
		local fallbackRoot = Instance.new("Part")
		fallbackRoot.Name = "RootPart"
		fallbackRoot.Size = Vector3.new(0.2, 0.2, 0.2)
		fallbackRoot.Transparency = 1
		fallbackRoot.Anchored = true
		fallbackRoot.CanCollide = false
		fallbackRoot.CanQuery = false
		fallbackRoot.CanTouch = false
		fallbackRoot.Massless = true
		fallbackRoot.Parent = model
		model.PrimaryPart = fallbackRoot
		foundRoot = fallbackRoot
	else
		model.PrimaryPart = foundRoot
	end

	local foundMesh = model:FindFirstChild("WeaponMesh", true)
	if not foundMesh or not foundMesh:IsA("BasePart") then
		foundMesh = foundRoot
	end

	local foundAim = model:FindFirstChild("AimPart", true)
	if not foundAim or not foundAim:IsA("BasePart") then
		local createdAim = Instance.new("Part")
		createdAim.Name = "AimPart"
		createdAim.Size = Vector3.new(0.1, 0.1, 0.1)
		createdAim.Transparency = 1
		createdAim.Anchored = false
		createdAim.CanCollide = false
		createdAim.CanQuery = false
		createdAim.CanTouch = false
		createdAim.Massless = true
		createdAim.CFrame = foundRoot.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0.2, 0.15)
		createdAim.Parent = model

		local weld = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
		weld.Part0 = foundRoot
		weld.Part1 = createdAim
		weld.Parent = foundRoot
		foundAim = createdAim
	end

	local foundMuzzle = model:FindFirstChild("MuzzleAttachment", true)
	if not foundMuzzle or not foundMuzzle:IsA("Attachment") then
		local createdMuzzle = Instance.new("Attachment")
		createdMuzzle.Name = "MuzzleAttachment"
		createdMuzzle.Position = Vector3.new(0, 0.04, -(foundMesh :: BasePart).Size.Z * 0.5)
		createdMuzzle.Parent = foundMesh
		foundMuzzle = createdMuzzle
	end

	for _, desc in model:GetDescendants() do
		if desc:IsA("BasePart") then
			desc.CanCollide = false
			desc.CanQuery = false
			desc.CanTouch = false
			desc.Massless = true
			desc.CastShadow = false
		end
	end

	rootPart = foundRoot :: BasePart
	weaponMesh = foundMesh :: BasePart
	aimPart = foundAim :: BasePart
	muzzleAttachment = foundMuzzle :: Attachment
end

local function updateRenderStep(dt: number)
	local camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
	local currentRoot = rootPart
	local currentAim = aimPart
	if not camera or not activeViewmodel or not currentRoot or not currentAim then
		return
	end

	if activeViewmodel.Parent ~= camera then
		activeViewmodel.Parent = camera
	end

	-- 1. Mouse delta sway & springs
	local mouseDelta = UserInputService:GetMouseDelta()
	local swayScale = if isADSState then 0.0012 else 0.0032
	swaySpring.Target = Vector3.new(
		math.clamp(-mouseDelta.X * swayScale, -0.14, 0.14),
		math.clamp(mouseDelta.Y * swayScale, -0.14, 0.14),
		0
	)
	local swayPos = swaySpring:Update(dt)
	local recoilPos = recoilPosSpring:Update(dt)
	local recoilRot = recoilRotSpring:Update(dt)
	local landingOffset = landingSpring:Update(dt)

	-- 2. Air-strafe roll tilt (±4.5° on A/D, -8° on slide)
	local strafeInput = 0
	if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) then
		strafeInput += 1
	end
	if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) then
		strafeInput -= 1
	end

	local targetRollDeg = if isSlidingActive() then SLIDE_ROLL_DEG else (strafeInput * STRAFE_ROLL_DEG)
	local targetRollRad = math.rad(targetRollDeg)
	local rollLerpAlpha = 1 - math.exp(-14 * dt)
	currentRollRad = currentRollRad + (targetRollRad - currentRollRad) * rollLerpAlpha

	-- 3. Subtle movement velocity bob
	local speed = getHorizontalSpeed()
	local bobAmplitude = math.clamp(speed / 28, 0, 1.2) * (if isADSState then 0.006 else 0.025)
	bobPhase += dt * math.clamp(speed * 0.45, 2.5, 14)
	local bobX = math.cos(bobPhase) * bobAmplitude
	local bobY = math.abs(math.sin(bobPhase)) * -bobAmplitude

	-- 4. Procedural reload envelope (tilting 28° on Z and dipping -0.22 studs on Y over duration)
	local targetReloadAlpha = 0
	if isProceduralReloading then
		reloadElapsed += dt
		if reloadElapsed >= reloadDuration then
			isProceduralReloading = false
			reloadElapsed = 0
			targetReloadAlpha = 0
		else
			local progress = math.clamp(reloadElapsed / reloadDuration, 0, 1)
			if progress < 0.2 then
				targetReloadAlpha = math.sin((progress / 0.2) * (math.pi * 0.5))
			elseif progress > 0.8 then
				targetReloadAlpha = math.sin(((1 - progress) / 0.2) * (math.pi * 0.5))
			else
				targetReloadAlpha = 1
			end
		end
	end
	currentReloadAlpha += (targetReloadAlpha - currentReloadAlpha) * (1 - math.exp(-18 * dt))

	local reloadOffsetY = RELOAD_DIP_Y * currentReloadAlpha
	local reloadTiltZ = RELOAD_TILT_Z_RAD * currentReloadAlpha

	-- 5. Dynamic AimPart:ToObjectSpace ADS interpolation
	local targetAds = if isADSState and not isProceduralReloading then 1 else 0
	local adsSpeed = 16
	local wConfig = getWeaponConfig(currentWeaponId)
	if type(wConfig) == "table" and type(wConfig.AimSpeed) == "number" then
		adsSpeed = wConfig.AimSpeed
	end
	adsAlpha = adsAlpha + (targetAds - adsAlpha) * (1 - math.exp(-adsSpeed * dt))

	local aimToRoot = currentAim.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(currentRoot.CFrame)
	local adsTargetCFrame = ADS_EYE_RELIEF * aimToRoot
	local baseOffset = HIP_OFFSET:Lerp(adsTargetCFrame, adsAlpha)

	-- 6. Combine procedural springs, 3D positional + rotational recoil, reload offset, and roll
	local proceduralTranslation = Vector3.new(
		swayPos.X + bobX + recoilPos.X,
		swayPos.Y + bobY + landingOffset.Y + recoilPos.Y + reloadOffsetY,
		recoilPos.Z
	)

	local proceduralRotation = CFrame.Angles(
		recoilRot.X + (landingOffset.Y * 0.35) - (swayPos.Y * 0.8),
		recoilRot.Y - (swayPos.X * 1.1),
		currentRollRad + recoilRot.Z + reloadTiltZ - (swayPos.X * 1.4)
	)

	currentRoot.CFrame = camera.CFrame * baseOffset * CFrame.new(proceduralTranslation) * proceduralRotation
end

function ViewmodelController.EquipWeaponViewmodel(weaponId: string)
	currentWeaponId = weaponId
	isProceduralReloading = false
	reloadElapsed = 0
	currentReloadAlpha = 0

	if activeViewmodel then
		AnimatorBridge.StopAll()
		activeViewmodel:Destroy()
		activeViewmodel = nil
		rootPart = nil
		aimPart = nil
		weaponMesh = nil
		muzzleAttachment = nil
	end

	local model = tryLoadModelFromRegistry(weaponId) or constructProceduralViewmodel(weaponId)
	bindViewmodelParts(model)

	local camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
	if camera then
		model.Parent = camera
	end

	activeViewmodel = model

	AnimatorBridge.BindRig(model, weaponId)
	AnimatorBridge.PlayTrack("Equip")
	AnimatorBridge.PlayTrack("Idle")
end

ViewmodelController.EquipWeapon = ViewmodelController.EquipWeaponViewmodel
ViewmodelController.SwitchWeapon = ViewmodelController.EquipWeaponViewmodel

function ViewmodelController.ApplyRecoilImpulse(kickPos: Vector3, kickRot: Vector3?)
	local adsMultiplier = if isADSState then 0.65 else 1.0
	local resolvedRot = kickRot
	if not resolvedRot then
		local wConfig = getWeaponConfig(currentWeaponId)
		if type(wConfig) == "table" and typeof(wConfig.RecoilKickRot) == "Vector3" then
			resolvedRot = wConfig.RecoilKickRot
		else
			resolvedRot = Vector3.new(
				math.abs(kickPos.Y) * 1.4 + math.abs(kickPos.Z) * 0.6,
				kickPos.X * 0.5,
				kickPos.X * 0.35
			)
		end
	end

	recoilPosSpring:Impulse(kickPos * adsMultiplier)
	recoilRotSpring:Impulse((resolvedRot :: Vector3) * adsMultiplier)
end

function ViewmodelController.PlayFireAnimation()
	AnimatorBridge.PlayTrack("Fire")
end

function ViewmodelController.PlayReloadAnimation(duration: number)
	local resolvedDuration = if type(duration) == "number" and duration > 0 then duration else 1.5
	local trackPlayed = AnimatorBridge.PlayTrack("Reload")
	if not trackPlayed then
		isProceduralReloading = true
		reloadElapsed = 0
		reloadDuration = resolvedDuration
	end
end

function ViewmodelController.GetMuzzleAttachment(): Attachment?
	return muzzleAttachment
end

function ViewmodelController.GetMuzzleWorldPosition(): Vector3?
	if muzzleAttachment then
		return muzzleAttachment.WorldPosition
	end
	if weaponMesh then
		return (weaponMesh.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, -weaponMesh.Size.Z * 0.5)).Position
	end
	return nil
end

function ViewmodelController.IsADS(): boolean
	return isADSState
end

function ViewmodelController.Init()
	if isInitialized then
		return
	end
	isInitialized = true

	-- Subscribe landing compression spring to MovementController.OnLandedCallbacks
	if type(MovementController) == "table" and type(MovementController.OnLandedCallbacks) == "table" then
		table.insert(MovementController.OnLandedCallbacks, function(impactSpeed: number?)
			local speed = if type(impactSpeed) == "number" then math.abs(impactSpeed) else 28
			local compression = math.clamp(speed / 55, 0.2, 1.35)
			landingSpring:Impulse(Vector3.new(0, -compression * 2.2, 0))
		end)
	end

	-- Track right mouse button ADS state
	table.insert(
		inputConnections,
		UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input: InputObject, gameProcessed: boolean)
			if not gameProcessed and input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2 then
				isADSState = true
			end
		end)
	)

	table.insert(
		inputConnections,
		UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input: InputObject, _gameProcessed: boolean)
			if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2 then
				isADSState = false
			end
		end)
	)

	if not activeViewmodel then
		ViewmodelController.EquipWeaponViewmodel(currentWeaponId)
	end

	RunService:BindToRenderStep(RENDER_STEP_NAME, Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 1, updateRenderStep)
end

return table.freeze(ViewmodelController)
````

--!strict
--[[

local function createProceduralViewmodel(name: string): Model
	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = name

	local isRailgun = name == "HELIOS_RAIL"
		or name == "RailgunViewmodel"
		or name == "Railgun"

	local meshSize = if isRailgun then Vector3.new(0.32, 0.42, 2.5) else Vector3.new(0.36, 0.44, 1.75)
	local sightHeight = if isRailgun then 0.28 else 0.25
	local accentColor = if isRailgun
		then Color3.fromRGB(255, 140, 35)
		else Color3.fromRGB(0, 225, 255)

	local rootPart = Instance.new("Part")
	rootPart.Name = "RootPart"
	rootPart.Size = Vector3.new(0.5, 0.5, 0.5)
	rootPart.Transparency = 1
	rootPart.Anchored = false
	rootPart.CanCollide = false
	rootPart.CanQuery = false
	rootPart.CanTouch = false
	rootPart.Massless = true
	rootPart.Parent = model

	local weaponMesh = Instance.new("Part")
	weaponMesh.Name = "WeaponMesh"
	weaponMesh.Size = meshSize
	weaponMesh.Color = Color3.fromRGB(35, 42, 55)
	weaponMesh.Material = Enum.Material.Metal
	weaponMesh.Anchored = false
	weaponMesh.CanCollide = false
	weaponMesh.CanQuery = false
	weaponMesh.CanTouch = false
	weaponMesh.Massless = true
	weaponMesh.Parent = model

	local barrelAccent = Instance.new("Part")
	barrelAccent.Name = "BarrelAccent"
	barrelAccent.Size = Vector3.new(meshSize.X * 0.45, meshSize.Y * 0.35, meshSize.Z * 0.85)
	barrelAccent.Color = accentColor
	barrelAccent.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
	barrelAccent.Anchored = false
	barrelAccent.CanCollide = false
	barrelAccent.CanQuery = false
	barrelAccent.CanTouch = false
	barrelAccent.Massless = true
	barrelAccent.CFrame = weaponMesh.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0.04, -0.08)
	barrelAccent.Parent = model

	local accentWeld = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
	accentWeld.Name = "AccentWeld"
	accentWeld.Part0 = weaponMesh
	accentWeld.Part1 = barrelAccent
	accentWeld.Parent = weaponMesh

	local weaponMotor = Instance.new("Motor6D")
	weaponMotor.Name = "WeaponMotor"
	weaponMotor.Part0 = rootPart
	weaponMotor.Part1 = weaponMesh
	weaponMotor.C0 = CFrame.identity
	weaponMotor.C1 = CFrame.identity
	weaponMotor.Parent = rootPart

	local aimPart = Instance.new("Part")
	aimPart.Name = "AimPart"
	aimPart.Size = Vector3.new(0.2, 0.2, 0.2)
	aimPart.Transparency = 1
	aimPart.Anchored = false
	aimPart.CanCollide = false
	aimPart.CanQuery = false
	aimPart.CanTouch = false
	aimPart.Massless = true
	aimPart.Parent = model

	local aimMotor = Instance.new("Motor6D")
	aimMotor.Name = "AimMotor"
	aimMotor.Part0 = rootPart
	aimMotor.Part1 = aimPart
	aimMotor.C0 = CFrame.new(0, sightHeight, 0.15)
	aimMotor.C1 = CFrame.identity
	aimMotor.Parent = rootPart

	local muzzleAttachment = Instance.new("Attachment")
	muzzleAttachment.Name = "MuzzleAttachment"
	muzzleAttachment.Position = Vector3.new(0, 0.04, -weaponMesh.Size.Z * 0.5)
	muzzleAttachment.Parent = weaponMesh

	local animController = Instance.new("AnimationController")
	animController.Parent = model
	local animator = Instance.new("Animator")
	animator.Parent = animController

	model.PrimaryPart = rootPart
	return model
end

local function createProceduralWorldmodel(name: string): Model
	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = name

	local handle = Instance.new("Part")
	handle.Name = "Handle"
	handle.Size = Vector3.new(0.3, 0.4, 1.6)
	handle.Color = Color3.fromRGB(45, 50, 65)
	handle.Material = Enum.Material.Metal
	handle.Anchored = false
	handle.CanCollide = false
	handle.CanQuery = false
	handle.CanTouch = false
	handle.Massless = true
	handle.Parent = model

	local muzzleAttachment = Instance.new("Attachment")
	muzzleAttachment.Name = "MuzzleAttachment"
	muzzleAttachment.Position = Vector3.new(0, 0.1, -0.8)
	muzzleAttachment.Parent = handle

	model.PrimaryPart = handle
	return model
end

local function createProceduralCharacterRig(name: string): Model
	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = name

	local rootPart = Instance.new("Part")
	rootPart.Name = "HumanoidRootPart"
	rootPart.Size = Vector3.new(2, 2, 1)
	rootPart.Transparency = 1
	rootPart.CanCollide = false
	rootPart.Parent = model

	local torso = Instance.new("Part")
	torso.Name = "Torso"
	torso.Size = Vector3.new(2, 2, 1)
	torso.Color = Color3.fromRGB(50, 65, 90)
	torso.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
	torso.CanCollide = true
	torso.Parent = model

	local head = Instance.new("Part")
	head.Name = "Head"
	head.Size = Vector3.new(1.2, 1.2, 1.2)
	head.Color = Color3.fromRGB(220, 230, 240)
	head.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
	head.CanCollide = false
	head.Parent = model

	local rootJoint = Instance.new("Motor6D")
	rootJoint.Name = "RootJoint"
	rootJoint.Part0 = rootPart
	rootJoint.Part1 = torso
	rootJoint.Parent = rootPart

	local neck = Instance.new("Motor6D")
	neck.Name = "Neck"
	neck.Part0 = torso
	neck.Part1 = head
	neck.C0 = CFrame.new(0, 1.5, 0)
	neck.Parent = torso

	local humanoid = Instance.new("Humanoid")
	humanoid.RigType = Enum.HumanoidRigType.R6
	humanoid.Parent = model

	local animator = Instance.new("Animator")
	animator.Parent = humanoid

	model.PrimaryPart = rootPart
	return model
end

local function findAssetInstance(categoryFolder: string, assetName: string): Model?
	local assetsFolder = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Assets")
	if not assetsFolder then
		return nil
	end
	local modelsFolder = assetsFolder:FindFirstChild("Models")
	if not modelsFolder then
		return nil
	end
	local subFolder = modelsFolder:FindFirstChild(categoryFolder)
	if not subFolder then
		return nil
	end
	local found = subFolder:FindFirstChild(assetName)
	if found and found:IsA("Model") then
		return found
	end
	return nil
end

local AssetRegistry = {
	Audio = Audio,
	UISprites = UISprites,
	NetworkEvents = NetworkEvents,

	GetViewmodel = function(viewmodelKey: string): Model
		local template = findAssetInstance("Viewmodels", viewmodelKey)
		if template then
			return template:Clone()
		end
		return createProceduralViewmodel(viewmodelKey)
	end,

	GetWorldmodel = function(worldmodelKey: string): Model
		local template = findAssetInstance("Worldmodels", worldmodelKey)
		if template then
			return template:Clone()
		end
		return createProceduralWorldmodel(worldmodelKey)
	end,

	GetCharacterRig = function(rigKey: string?): Model
		local targetName = rigKey or "CompetitiveR6"
		local template = findAssetInstance("Characters", targetName)
		if template then
			return template:Clone()
		end
		return createProceduralCharacterRig(targetName)
	end,
}

return table.freeze(AssetRegistry)
````

--!strict
--[[
	MovementConfig.luau
	Read-only movement, bunny-hop, air-strafe, slide, and camera physics constants.
	Includes strict alias keys for MovementController and SlideController compatibility.
]]

export type MovementConfigType = {
	-- Ground Movement
	GroundWalkSpeed: number,
	MaxGroundSpeed: number,
	WalkSpeed: number,
	GroundSprintSpeed: number,

	FOVSpeedThreshold: number,
	FOVMaxSpeedReference: number,
	FOVLerpSpeed: number,
	StrafeTiltMaxDegrees: number,
	SlideTiltDegrees: number,
}

## File: src/shared/network/ShotPacket.luau
````
--!strict
--[[
	ShotPacket.luau
	28-byte binary buffer serializer and deserializer for client-to-server hitscan fire packets.

	Byte Layout (28 bytes total, little-endian):
	  [0..7]   f64 : timestamp (workspace:GetServerTimeNow())
	  [8..11]  f32 : origin.X
	  [12..15] f32 : origin.Y
	  [16..19] f32 : origin.Z
	  [20..23] f32 : pitch (radians, clamped to [-pi/2, pi/2])
	  [24..27] f32 : yaw   (radians)
]]

local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local PACKET_SIZE = 28
local HALF_PI = math.pi * 0.5

export type DecodedShotPacket = {
	Timestamp: number,
	Origin: Vector3,
	Direction: Vector3,
	Pitch: number,
	Yaw: number,
}

local ShotPacket = {
	PACKET_SIZE = PACKET_SIZE,
}

local function isFinite(n: number): boolean
	return n == n and n ~= math.huge and n ~= -math.huge
end

function ShotPacket.DirectionToPitchYaw(dir: Vector3): (number, number)
	local unitDir = if dir.Magnitude > 1e-6 then dir.Unit else -Vector3.zAxis
	local pitch = math.asin(math.clamp(unitDir.Y, -1, 1))
	local yaw = math.atan2(-unitDir.X, -unitDir.Z)
	return pitch, yaw
end

--[[
	Supports both calling conventions without throwing:
	1. ShotPacket.Encode(timestamp: number, origin: Vector3, pitch: number, yaw: number): buffer
	2. Overload for table or (origin: Vector3, direction: Vector3, timestamp: number?, weaponId: number?)
]]
function ShotPacket.Encode(a: any, b: any?, c: any?, d: any?): buffer
	local timestamp: number = 0
	local origin: Vector3 = Vector3.zero
	local pitch: number = 0
	local yaw: number = 0

	if type(a) == "table" then
		local tbl = a :: { [string]: any }
		timestamp = if type(tbl.Timestamp) == "number"
			then tbl.Timestamp
			elseif type(tbl.timestamp) == "number" then tbl.timestamp
			else Workspace:GetServerTimeNow()

		origin = if typeof(tbl.Origin) == "Vector3"
			then tbl.Origin
			elseif typeof(tbl.origin) == "Vector3" then tbl.origin
			else Vector3.zero

		local dir = tbl.Direction or tbl.direction or tbl.LookVector or tbl.lookVector
		if typeof(dir) == "Vector3" then
			pitch, yaw = ShotPacket.DirectionToPitchYaw(dir)
		else
			pitch = tonumber(tbl.Pitch or tbl.pitch) or 0
			yaw = tonumber(tbl.Yaw or tbl.yaw) or 0
		end
	elseif typeof(a) == "Vector3" then
		-- Overload: (origin: Vector3, direction: Vector3, timestamp: number?, weaponId: number?)
		origin = a
		if typeof(b) == "Vector3" then
			pitch, yaw = ShotPacket.DirectionToPitchYaw(b)
		else
			pitch = if type(b) == "number" then b else 0
			yaw = if type(c) == "number" then c else 0
		end
		timestamp = if type(c) == "number" then c else Workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
	else
		-- Standard: (timestamp: number, origin: Vector3, pitch: number, yaw: number)
		timestamp = if type(a) == "number" then a else Workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
		origin = if typeof(b) == "Vector3" then b else Vector3.zero
		if typeof(c) == "Vector3" then
			pitch, yaw = ShotPacket.DirectionToPitchYaw(c)
		else
			pitch = if type(c) == "number" then c else 0
			yaw = if type(d) == "number" then d else 0
		end
	end

	pitch = math.clamp(pitch, -HALF_PI, HALF_PI)

	local buf = buffer.create(PACKET_SIZE)
	buffer.writef64(buf, 0, timestamp)
	buffer.writef32(buf, 8, origin.X)
	buffer.writef32(buf, 12, origin.Y)
	buffer.writef32(buf, 16, origin.Z)
	buffer.writef32(buf, 20, pitch)
	buffer.writef32(buf, 24, yaw)

	return buf
end

function ShotPacket.Decode(buf: buffer): (boolean, number, Vector3, Vector3)
	if typeof(buf) ~= "buffer" or buffer.len(buf) ~= PACKET_SIZE then
		return false, 0, Vector3.zero, -Vector3.zAxis
	end

	local timestamp = buffer.readf64(buf, 0)
	local ox = buffer.readf32(buf, 8)
	local oy = buffer.readf32(buf, 12)
	local oz = buffer.readf32(buf, 16)
	local pitch = buffer.readf32(buf, 20)
	local yaw = buffer.readf32(buf, 24)

	if
		not isFinite(timestamp)
		or not isFinite(ox)
		or not isFinite(oy)
		or not isFinite(oz)
		or not isFinite(pitch)
		or not isFinite(yaw)
	then
		return false, 0, Vector3.zero, -Vector3.zAxis
	end

	local clampedPitch = math.clamp(pitch, -HALF_PI, HALF_PI)
	local origin = Vector3.new(ox, oy, oz)

	local cosPitch = math.cos(clampedPitch)
	local lookDir = Vector3.new(
		-math.sin(yaw) * cosPitch,
		math.sin(clampedPitch),
		-math.cos(yaw) * cosPitch
	)

	local lookVector = if lookDir.Magnitude > 1e-6 then lookDir.Unit else -Vector3.zAxis
	return true, timestamp, origin, lookVector
end

function ShotPacket.DecodeTable(buf: buffer): DecodedShotPacket?
	local isValid, timestamp, origin, lookVector = ShotPacket.Decode(buf)
	if not isValid then
		return nil
	end

	local rawPitch = math.clamp(buffer.readf32(buf, 20), -HALF_PI, HALF_PI)
	local rawYaw = buffer.readf32(buf, 24)

	return {
		Timestamp = timestamp,
		Origin = origin,
		Direction = lookVector,
		Pitch = rawPitch,
		Yaw = rawYaw,
	}
end

return table.freeze(ShotPacket)
````
